# Upgrading from 1.10 to 2.0.0

2.0.0 changes the public interface of every binding, the C ABI and both command-line front-ends. No 1.10 spelling is kept as an alias: a renamed function, argument, field, flag or token is refused under its old name, and a JSON document written by 1.10 that uses a removed key or token is refused with `InvalidFormat` naming the current spelling. Nothing converts an old document on load.

The guide has one section per surface, and inside it one section per area of the library. Each area groups its changes by the convention behind them: the heading states the convention, and the table lists every affected name. The left column is the 1.x name; the right column is the 2.0.0 name when only the name changed, `removed:` and what to use instead (or `removed, no replacement:` and why), or the change a caller has to make when the name stays. The conventions themselves, with a before and after for each, close the guide.

## C

Configuration structs carry `struct_size` and are seeded by their `*_init` function, which writes every default; a field the header documents as optional is left NaN (a float) or at its named constant to mean not given. Constructors return `SonareError` and hand the object back through an out pointer, and every result is released by the function named after the struct it releases. Rebuild every consumer against the 2.0.0 headers.

### C: Loading, versions, audio buffers and errors

#### Seconds are spelled Sec and _sec

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `sonare_audio_duration` | `sonare_audio_duration_sec` |

#### C extends an operation through an Options struct

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `sonare_audio_from_file` | takes const SonareAudioFileOptions* options (NULL = downmix; sonare_audio_file_options_init) before out; channel_index selects one channel and SONARE_AUDIO_CHANNEL_DOWNMIX (-1, the default) downmixes |

#### C results are released by a function named after the result

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `sonare_audio_free` | `sonare_audio_destroy` |
| `sonare_capabilities_json` | returns SonareError and writes a caller-owned document through out_json, released with sonare_free_string |

#### Every C failure sets the error message

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `sonare_last_diagnostic_code` | `sonare_last_diagnostic` |
| `sonare_last_diagnostic_message` | `sonare_last_diagnostic` |
| `sonare_last_diagnostic_severity` | `sonare_last_diagnostic` |
| `sonare_last_warning_message` | `sonare_last_diagnostic` |

#### Each operation has exactly one entry point

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `sonare_audio_from_file_channel` | removed: call sonare_audio_from_file with SonareAudioFileOptions channel_index set |

#### Versions and features come from *AbiVersion() and capabilities()

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `SONARE_VOCAL_EDIT_API_VERSION` | `SONARE_VOCAL_EDIT_ABI_VERSION` |
| `SONARE_VOCAL_PROJECT_API_VERSION` | `SONARE_VOCAL_PROJECT_ABI_VERSION` |
| `sonare_has_ffmpeg_support` | removed: call sonare_has_feature("ffmpeg"), which returns 1 when the FFmpeg decode path is compiled in |
| `sonare_vocal_available` | removed: call sonare_has_feature("vocalEdit"), which returns 1 when vocal editing is compiled in |
| `sonare_vocal_edit_api_version` | `sonare_vocal_edit_abi_version` |

#### Loudness quantities use one name per measurement

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `SonareDynamicsResult.loudness_range_db` | `SonareDynamicsResult.loudness_range_lu` |
| `SonareLufsResult.loudness_range` | `SonareLufsResult.loudness_range_lu` |

#### A value that is not given is absent, never 0, -1 or ''

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `SonarePolyphonicConfig` | leads with uint32_t struct_size instead of struct_version; prepare it with sonare_polyphonic_config_init, after which every field is read literally and range-checked (a 0 is a 0, so min_frame_peak_ratio, min_separation_cents, min_ridge_peak_ratio and min_ridge_duration_ms take 0 directly and refuse a negative); reattack_ratio moves beside the other tracking fields; win_length 0 (n_fft), max_refine_hz 0 (derived) and reattack_ratio 0 (no split) keep their named meanings |
| `SonareTranscribeConfig.reattack_ratio` | 0 now means no split (1.x: 0 was the default 2.0 and a negative value meant no split); a non-zero value must be finite and above 1 |
| `sonare_griffin_lim` | pass a hop_length of 0 for a quarter of n_fft; the hop is a size_t |
| `sonare_mel_to_audio` | pass a hop_length of 0 for a quarter of n_fft; the hop is a size_t; takes size_t input_length after mel, which must equal n_mels * n_frames, and const SonareMelToAudioOptions* options (NULL = defaults; sonare_mel_to_audio_options_init) before out; htk moved into the struct |
| `sonare_mfcc_to_audio` | pass a hop_length of 0 for a quarter of n_fft; the hop is a size_t; takes size_t input_length after coefficients, which must equal n_mfcc * n_frames, and const SonareMfccToAudioOptions* options (NULL = defaults; sonare_mfcc_to_audio_options_init) before out; htk and lifter moved into the struct |
| `sonare_note_segments` | takes (f0_hz, voiced_prob, voiced_flags, n_frames, frame_rate, config, out): exactly one of voiced_prob and voiced_flags is non-NULL, and voiced flags read as 0/1 probabilities |
| `sonare_vqt` | gamma is NaN for the automatic ERB-derived value and otherwise finite and >= 0; a negative gamma, which selected the automatic value, is refused with SONARE_ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER 'gamma must be finite and at least 0' |

#### An option left out takes the library's default

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `SonareMeterOptions.compound_subdivision_threshold` | the threshold is read on a new scale, the mean accent between the beats as a fraction of the mean accent on them with only a midpoint holding an attack contributing, and its default moves from 0.85 to 0.5, the one calibrated point between the scales; a value set explicitly has to be chosen again on the new scale, not converted by formula |

#### Closed sets are string unions, not numbers or IntEnums

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `SonareChordDetectionOptions.chroma_method` | chroma_method is a SonareChromaMethod (SONARE_CHROMA_METHOD_STFT, _NNLS, _CQT); the ordinals are unchanged |
| `sonare_vector_normalize(norm_type)` | `sonare_vector_normalize(norm)`: norm_type is a SonareNormType (SONARE_NORM_MAX, _L1, _L2, _POWER); the ordinals are unchanged |

#### Progress is an onProgress option, not a separate function

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `sonare_analyze_json_ex_with_progress` | removed: call sonare_analyze_json with progress_callback, progress_user_data, cancel_callback and cancel_user_data set in SonareMusicAnalyzeOptions |
| `sonare_analyze_json_with_progress_ex` | removed: call sonare_analyze_json with SonareMusicAnalyzeOptions carrying progress_callback, cancel_callback and their user data |
| `sonare_analyze_json_with_progress` | removed: call sonare_analyze_json with options NULL, or with SonareMusicAnalyzeOptions carrying progress_callback |

#### Public tempo searches default to 60-200 BPM

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `sonare_audio_detect_beats` | takes bpm_min and bpm_max before out_times, as sonare_detect_beats does |
| `sonare_audio_detect_bpm` | takes bpm_min and bpm_max before out_bpm, as sonare_detect_bpm does |
| `sonare_detect_beats` | takes bpm_min and bpm_max before out_times; pass 60 and 200 for the shared search, an inverted range is INVALID_PARAMETER |
| `sonare_detect_bpm` | takes bpm_min and bpm_max before out_bpm; pass 60 and 200 for the shared search, an inverted range is INVALID_PARAMETER |

#### A C matrix result reports its buffer length and named dimensions

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `sonare_piptrack` | takes out_pitches and out_magnitudes first, then size_t* out_length (shared by both buffers), int* out_n_bins and int* out_n_frames |
| `sonare_poly_features` | takes size_t* out_length after out, then int* out_n_coefficients (order + 1) and int* out_n_frames in place of int* out_rows, int* out_cols |
| `sonare_spectral_contrast` | takes size_t* out_length after out, then int* out_n_subbands (n_bands + 1) and int* out_n_frames in place of int* out_rows, int* out_cols |

#### Every C failure sets the error message

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `sonare_hz_to_note` | returns SonareError and writes a caller-owned name through out_string, released with sonare_free_string |

#### Each operation has exactly one entry point

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `sonare_stft_db` | removed: call sonare_stft with SonareStftOptions db set and read SonareStftResult.db |
| `sonare_stream_analyzer_process_with_offset` | removed: call sonare_stream_analyzer_process with a non-NULL sample_offset |
| `sonare_stream_analyzer_process` | takes const size_t* sample_offset after n_samples: NULL tracks the cumulative offset internally as before, non-NULL is the explicit offset of the chunk |
| `sonare_tempogram_with_mode` | removed: call sonare_tempogram, which takes the mode |
| `sonare_tempogram` | takes int mode (SonareTempogramMode: SONARE_TEMPOGRAM_AUTOCORRELATION is the form the entry computed before) after norm |

| `sonare_streaming_retune_create(grain_size)` | `sonare_streaming_retune_create(grain_size_samples)` |

| `sonare_streaming_retune_set_config(grain_size)` | `sonare_streaming_retune_set_config(grain_size_samples)` |

#### A value that is not given is absent, never 0, -1 or ''

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `SONARE_REVERB_MODEL_DEFAULT` | removed: start the config from sonare_rir_synth_config_init or sonare_room_morph_config_init, which sets prefer_eyring to 1 (the Eyring model); write 0 for Sabine |
| `SONARE_REVERB_MODEL_EYRING` | removed: set prefer_eyring to a non-zero value on SonareRirSynthConfig or SonareRoomMorphConfig |
| `SONARE_REVERB_MODEL_SABINE` | removed: set prefer_eyring to 0 on SonareRirSynthConfig or SonareRoomMorphConfig |
| `SonareDenoiseReport` | embeds the packed SonareNoiseDetection, so detected grows and every later field moves; recompile against the 2.0 header |
| `SonareNoiseDetection` | the band levels are packed: band_count (size_t) follows floor_dbfs, band_floor_dbfs holds the measured bands low to high and band_floor_band the index of each, so read [0, band_count) of both arrays instead of skipping NaN across all 32 slots; a band no analysis bin reaches is left out rather than NaN |
| `SonareRirSynthConfig` | leads with uint32_t struct_size; prepare it with sonare_rir_synth_config_init, after which every field is read literally (seed 0, crossfade_ms 0, a 0 degC / 0 % climate are values, not defaults); source and listener stay all-NaN until set ("Spell an optional C float that has no _init default as NaN, seeded by _init") and then resolve to the default placement scaled to the room, so set all three components to place one, since a position only partly NaN is refused by component |
| `SonareRoomMorphConfig` | leads with uint32_t struct_size; prepare it with sonare_room_morph_config_init, after which every field is read literally (receiver_spacing_m 0 is refused rather than read as 0.5); source and listener stay all-NaN until set and then resolve to the default placement scaled to the target room, so set all three components to place one, since a position only partly NaN is refused by component |
| `SonareVoiceChangeConfig` | leads with uint32_t struct_size; prepare it with sonare_voice_change_config_init (pitch_semitones 0, formant_factor 1, formant_mode SONARE_FORMANT_MODE_RELATIVE), after which every field is read literally; a struct whose struct_size was not set is refused |
| `sonare_phase_vocoder` | pass a hop_length of 0 for a quarter of n_fft; the hop is a size_t |
| `sonare_streaming_retune_prepare` | max_block_size 0 is refused; pass the largest block the stream will process |

#### Seconds are spelled Sec and _sec

#### A value that is not given is absent, never 0, -1 or ''

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `SonareEngineBounceOptions` | leads with uint32_t struct_size; prepare it with sonare_engine_bounce_options_init, after which every field is read literally: block_size SONARE_ENGINE_BLOCK_SIZE_AUTO and the rates SONARE_ENGINE_SAMPLE_RATE_PREPARED (-1) take the defaults and 0 is refused; target_lufs NaN is the -14 LUFS default and any finite value is literal; dither_bits must be in range when dither is on; dither_seed is read literally (SONARE_ENGINE_DEFAULT_DITHER_SEED is the default) |
| `SonareEngineBuiltinSynthConfig` | leads with uint32_t struct_size; prepare it with sonare_engine_builtin_synth_config_init, after which every field is read literally and a value outside its domain is refused instead of replaced: gain in (0, 4], attack_ms, decay_ms and release_ms in (0, 20000], sustain in (0, 1], polyphony in [1, 64]; a 0 is no longer the default |
| `SonareEngineClip` | leads with uint32_t struct_size; prepare it with sonare_engine_clip_init, after which every field is read literally: length_samples SONARE_ENGINE_CLIP_LENGTH_TO_END (-1) plays to the end of the source and 0 is refused |
| `SonareEngineFreezeOptions` | leads with uint32_t struct_size; prepare it with sonare_engine_freeze_options_init, after which every field is read literally: block_size SONARE_ENGINE_BLOCK_SIZE_AUTO (-1) takes the default offline block and 0 is refused |
| `SonareEngineGraphNode` | leads with uint32_t struct_size; prepare it with sonare_engine_graph_node_init, after which every field is read literally: num_ports SONARE_ENGINE_GRAPH_PORTS_FROM_SPEC (-1) takes the port count from the graph spec and 0 is refused |
| `SonareEngineMetronomeConfig` | leads with uint32_t struct_size; prepare it with sonare_engine_metronome_config_init, after which every field is read literally: click_samples SONARE_ENGINE_METRONOME_CLICK_FROM_SEC (-1) derives the click from click_sec, and a click_samples or click_sec of 0 is refused; sonare_engine_metronome reports the struct the same way |
| `SonareEngineMidiClipSchedule` | leads with uint32_t struct_size; prepare it with sonare_engine_midi_clip_schedule_init, after which every field is read literally: length_samples SONARE_ENGINE_MIDI_CLIP_OPEN_ENDED (-1) is open-ended and 0 is refused; a looping clip needs loop_length_samples of at least 1, and an open-ended clip refuses a fade-out |
| `SonareEngineSf2InstrumentConfig` | leads with uint32_t struct_size instead of struct_version; prepare it with sonare_engine_sf2_instrument_config_init, after which every field is read literally: gain in [0, 4] (0 is silence), polyphony in [1, 64], the two flags 0 or non-zero with a negative refused, gs_efx_realization 0 or 1; a 0 gain or polyphony is no longer the default |
| `sonare_engine_bounce_options_default` | removed: call sonare_engine_bounce_options_init(&options) on a caller-owned struct instead; set num_channels before bouncing (a 0 width is refused) |

#### Errors are coded by cause on every surface

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `sonare_engine_set_midi_fx` | refuses malformed config_json, an unknown or renamed key and an invalid value with SONARE_ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER instead of SONARE_ERROR_INVALID_FORMAT, naming the key under the root config ('config.velocityGamma must be > 0', 'unknown key config.transpose_semitones (renamed to config.transposeSemitones)') |
| `sonare_engine_set_part_rig` | refuses malformed inserts_json, a wrong shape and an invalid chain with SONARE_ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER instead of SONARE_ERROR_INVALID_FORMAT, naming the place under the root inserts ('inserts must hold 1 to 8 entries for a chain rig', 'inserts[0].processor must name an insert processor'); a key an insert does not take is refused instead of ignored ('unknown key inserts[0].parmas (expected processor, params)'), and so is a params key the processor does not read ('unknown key inserts[0].params.drive (expected aliasing, ceiling, driveDb, mix)'); the project document's partRigs refuse a wrong type and a chain no player can build with SONARE_ERROR_INVALID_FORMAT instead of dropping the entry |

#### Errors are coded by cause on every surface

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `sonare_project_preview_midi_fx_count` | refuses malformed config_json, an unknown or renamed key and an invalid value with SONARE_ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER instead of SONARE_ERROR_INVALID_FORMAT, naming the key under the root config ('config.velocityGamma must be > 0', 'unknown key config.transpose_semitones (renamed to config.transposeSemitones)') |
| `sonare_project_set_part_rig` | refuses malformed inserts_json, a wrong shape and an invalid chain with SONARE_ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER instead of SONARE_ERROR_INVALID_FORMAT, naming the place under the root inserts ('inserts must hold 1 to 8 entries for a chain rig', 'inserts[0].processor must name an insert processor'); a key an insert does not take is refused instead of ignored ('unknown key inserts[0].parmas (expected processor, params)'), and so is a params key the processor does not read ('unknown key inserts[0].params.drive (expected aliasing, ceiling, driveDb, mix)'); the project document's partRigs refuse a wrong type and a chain no player can build with SONARE_ERROR_INVALID_FORMAT instead of dropping the entry |

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `SonareProjectMarker.name` | removed: read the name with sonare_project_marker_name_by_index |

| `sonare_project_bounce_with_instruments` | removed: call sonare_project_bounce with the instruments list of SonareProjectBounceOptions set |
| `sonare_project_bounce_with_sf2_instruments` | removed: call sonare_project_bounce with the sf2_instruments list of SonareProjectBounceOptions set |
| `sonare_project_bounce_with_synth_instruments` | removed: call sonare_project_bounce with the synth_instruments list of SonareProjectBounceOptions set |
| `sonare_project_compile_timeline` | removed: call sonare_project_compile with a non-NULL out_timeline |
| `sonare_project_compile` | takes SonareProjectTimeline** out_timeline after out: NULL compiles for diagnostics only as before, non-NULL also receives the compiled timeline |
| `sonare_project_set_marker_ex_name` | removed: call sonare_project_set_marker, which takes the name |
| `sonare_project_set_program_on_channel` | removed: call sonare_project_set_program, which takes group and channel |
| `sonare_project_set_program` | takes uint8_t group and uint8_t channel after clip_id (0 and 0 is the former call); the former sonare_project_set_program_on_channel contract |

## Python

Keyword arguments and attributes are snake_case, records are frozen dataclasses built from keyword arguments, a closed set is a lowerCamel string token, an option left out is `None`, and a quantity names its unit (`_hz`, `_sec`, `_db`). Every public type imports from `libsonare`.

### Python: Loading, versions, audio buffers and errors

#### Sample rate is required wherever samples are passed

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.from_buffer` | sample_rate is required; it no longer defaults to 48000 |

#### Sample rate is spelled sampleRate, sample_rate and --sample-rate

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.resample(target_sr)` | `Audio.resample(target_sample_rate)` |
| `Audio.time_stretch(rate)` | `Audio.time_stretch(speed_ratio)`: renamed to speed_ratio and required |

#### Seconds are spelled Sec and _sec

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.duration` | `Audio.duration_sec` |

#### Physical quantities carry their unit in the name

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.analyze(tuning)` | `Audio.analyze(tuning_cents)` |
| `Audio.analyze_dynamics(compression_threshold)` | `Audio.analyze_dynamics(compression_threshold_db)` |
| `Audio.detect_chords(min_duration)` | `Audio.detect_chords(min_duration_sec)` |
| `Audio.detect_chords(smoothing_window)` | `Audio.detect_chords(smoothing_window_sec)` |
| `Audio.detect_chords(tuning)` | `Audio.detect_chords(tuning_cents)` |
| `Audio.detect_clipping(threshold)` | `Audio.detect_clipping(threshold_db)`: threshold -> threshold_db, a level in dBFS in [-120, 0] instead of a linear amplitude (default 20*log10(0.999)); omitted or NaN hands the core its default and a level outside the range raises SonareValueError |
| `Audio.detect_key(tuning)` | `Audio.detect_key(tuning_cents)` |
| `Audio.mastering(ceiling_db)` | `Audio.mastering(ceiling_dbtp)`: the ceiling is held on a true-peak measurement, so the keyword carries dBTP; ceiling_db raises TypeError |

#### Loudness quantities use one name per measurement

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.ebur128_loudness_range` | `Audio.ebur128_loudness_range_lu` |
| `Audio.true_peak_db` | `Audio.true_peak_dbtp` |

#### A value that is not given is absent, never 0, -1 or ''

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.dynamic_range(hop_sec)` | None (the default) is the library default; an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `Audio.dynamic_range(window_sec)` | None (the default) is the library default; an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `Audio.mastering(release_ms)` | absent is None (the library default 50 ms); an explicit 0 or a negative value raises SonareValueError |
| `Audio.spectrum(db_amin)` | None (the default) is the library default; an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `Audio.spectrum(db_ref)` | None (the default) is the library default; an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `Audio.spectrum(n_fft)` | None (the default) is the library default; an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `Audio.spectrum(octave_fraction)` | None (the default) is the library default; an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `Audio.spectrum_frame(db_amin)` | None (the default) is the library default; an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `Audio.spectrum_frame(db_ref)` | None (the default) is the library default; an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `Audio.spectrum_frame(n_fft)` | None (the default) is the library default; an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `Audio.spectrum_frame(octave_fraction)` | None (the default) is the library default; an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `Audio.true_peak_db(oversample_factor)` | `Audio.true_peak_dbtp(oversample_factor)`: None (the default) is 4; an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `project_abi_version` | returns None instead of 0 when arrangement support is compiled out |
| `vocal_edit_api_version` | `vocal_edit_abi_version`: returns None instead of a number when vocal edit is compiled out |
| `voice_changer_abi_version` | returns None instead of 0 when the voice changer is compiled out |

#### An option left out takes the library's default

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.detect_clipping(min_region_samples)` | omitted or 0 hands the core its default (was the literal 1) |
| `Audio.mastering(true_peak_oversample)` | omitted hands the core its default (was the literal 4); an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `Audio.pitch_correct_to_midi(current_midi)` | current_midi is required (1.x substituted MIDI 69, which nothing measured); pass the note the audio sits on and the note to move it to |
| `Audio.pitch_correct_to_midi(target_midi)` | target_midi is required (1.x substituted MIDI 69, which nothing measured); pass the note the audio sits on and the note to move it to |

#### Closed sets are string unions, not numbers or IntEnums

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|

| `Mode` | `KeyMode`: replaced by KeyMode, a Literal of the lowercase mode tokens ("major" ... "locrian"); an int is refused with TypeError |

#### Python composite results are frozen dataclasses

| `CapabilitiesDecode` | a frozen dataclass read by attribute instead of a TypedDict read by key; lists are tuples |

|---|---|

#### Errors are coded by cause on every surface

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.from_file_channel` | removed: call Audio.from_file(path, channel_index) |
| `Audio.mastering_chain` | removed: call the method Audio.master_audio(overrides=config) with no preset; overrides={} returns the input |
| `Audio.stft_db` | removed: call Audio.stft(..., db=True) and read the result's db plane |

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.file_channel_count` | `Audio.file_num_channels` |

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.analyze(chroma_highpass_hz)` | `Audio.analyze(chroma_high_pass_hz)` |

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.pitch_pyin(fmax)` | `Audio.pitch_pyin(f0_max_hz)` |
| `Audio.pitch_pyin(fmin)` | `Audio.pitch_pyin(f0_min_hz)` |
| `Audio.pitch_yin(fmax)` | `Audio.pitch_yin(f0_max_hz)` |

#### Pitch and formant shifts are named in semitones

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.pitch_shift(semitones)` | `Audio.pitch_shift(pitch_semitones)`: renamed to pitch_semitones and required |

#### Each list input takes one item form

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.master_audio` | preset, overrides and on_progress are keyword-only; preset defaults to None (was "pop"), which runs overrides as the whole chain (overrides={} returns the input); neither given raises SonareValueError |
| `Audio.normalize(target_db)` | target_db is keyword-only and defaults to None, the default of the new mode keyword ("peak" 0.0 dBFS, "rms" -20.0 dBFS); a target above 0 dBFS or not finite raises SonareValueError |
| `Audio.voice_change_realtime(preset)` | `Audio.realtime_voice_changer_render(config)`: renamed to config and keyword-only, as the Node and WASM facades name it; a string is a lowerCamel preset id only (JSON text raises SonareValueError, parse it with json.loads), a mapping is a preset document or flat config, and any other type is TypeError |

#### Historical aliases are removed

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `CapabilityCatalogChain.aliases` | removed: a chain key resolves through its descriptor or list; there is no alias table to read |
| `CapabilityCatalogChainAlias` | removed: a chain key resolves through its descriptor or list; there is no alias table to read |

#### Versions and features come from *AbiVersion() and capabilities()

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `EXPECTED_ENGINE_ABI_VERSION` | removed: call engine_abi_version() |
| `has_ffmpeg_support` | removed: read capabilities().features.ffmpeg |
| `vocal_edit_available` | removed: read capabilities().features.vocal_edit |

#### Other individual changes

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.dynamic_range(high_percentile)` | a rank in [0, 1], low at most high; anything else raises SonareValueError |
| `Audio.dynamic_range(low_percentile)` | a rank in [0, 1], low at most high; anything else raises SonareValueError |
| `Audio.from_buffer(data)` | `Audio.from_buffer(samples)` |
| `Audio.mastering_process(processor_name)` | `Audio.mastering_apply_processor(processor)` |
| `Audio.pitch_yin(fill_na)` | removed: had no effect: YIN reads no fill flag |
| `libsonare[dev]` | removed: the development tools are dependency groups; contributors run `uv sync` in bindings/python |

| `detect_onsets(threshold)` | float \| None, default None: None selects the adaptive threshold and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |

| `frames_to_time` | a non-positive sr or hop_length raises SonareValueError (returned NaN) |
| `mel_to_audio(fmax)` | absent is None (librosa's default); an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `mel_to_stft(fmax)` | absent is None (librosa's default); an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `mfcc(fmax)` | absent is None (librosa's default); an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |

| `samples_to_frames(n_fft)` | absent is None (librosa's default); an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `time_to_frames` | a non-positive sr or hop_length raises SonareValueError (returned 0) |
| `transcribe(reattack_ratio)` | None means no split; an explicit 0, a negative value or a value up to 1 raises SonareValueError |

#### An option left out takes the library's default

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `estimate_meter(compound_subdivision_threshold)` | the threshold is read on a new scale, the mean accent between the beats as a fraction of the mean accent on them with only a midpoint holding an attack contributing, and its default moves from 0.85 to 0.5, the one calibrated point between the scales; a value set explicitly has to be chosen again on the new scale, not converted by formula |
| `griffin_lim(hop_length)` | omitted is n_fft // 4 instead of a fixed 512, so a small n_fft with no hop resynthesizes; an explicit 0 or negative hop raises SonareValueError naming the function |
| `griffin_lim(n_fft)` | omitted is implied by the bin count, (n_bins - 1) * 2 (was 2048); an explicit value that disagrees raises SonareValueError |
| `mel_to_audio(hop_length)` | omitted is n_fft // 4 instead of a fixed 512, so a small n_fft with no hop resynthesizes; an explicit 0 or negative hop raises SonareValueError naming the function |
| `mfcc_to_audio(hop_length)` | omitted is n_fft // 4 instead of a fixed 512, so a small n_fft with no hop resynthesizes; an explicit 0 or negative hop raises SonareValueError naming the function |

|---|---|
| `Key.mode` | a KeyMode token string instead of a Mode IntEnum |

| `KeyProfile.SHAATH` | `KeyProfile='shaath'` |
| `KeyProfile.TEMPERLEY` | `KeyProfile='temperley'` |
| `KeyProfile` | a Literal of lowerCamel tokens ("krumhanslSchmuckler", "faraldoEdmt", ...) instead of an IntEnum; ordinals raise TypeError and legacy aliases such as "ks" raise SonareValueError |
| `Section.type` | a SectionType token string instead of an IntEnum |
| `SectionType.BRIDGE` | `SectionType='bridge'` |
| `SectionType.CHORUS` | `SectionType='chorus'` |

| `SectionType` | a Literal of lowerCamel tokens ("intro", "preChorus", ...) instead of an IntEnum |

| `detect_key(modes)` | a list of KeyMode tokens or the group "majorMinor" / "all" / "modal"; "major-minor", "majmin", "diatonic" and ordinals are refused; an empty list raises SonareValueError (omit modes for the default set) |

| `tempogram(mode)` | a TempogramMode token; the "auto" and "ac" spellings are refused |

| `PiptrackResult` | importable from libsonare |
| `ReassignedSpectrogramResult` | importable from libsonare |

|---|---|
| `AnalysisBeatObservations.chordChange` | removed: read the BeatObservations.chord_change field |
| `AnalysisBeatObservations.lowFrequencyEnergy` | removed: read the BeatObservations.low_frequency_energy field |
| `AnalysisBeatObservations.onsetStrength` | removed: read the BeatObservations.onset_strength field |
| `EqSpectrumSnapshot.bandGainDb` | removed: read band_gain_db |
| `EqSpectrumSnapshot.lastAutoGainDb` | removed: read last_auto_gain_db |

| `EqSpectrumSnapshot.postRight` | removed: read post_right |
| `EqSpectrumSnapshot.preLeft` | removed: read pre_left |
| `EqSpectrumSnapshot.preRight` | removed: read pre_right |
| `EqSpectrumSnapshot.profileDb` | removed: read profile_db |
| `FunctionalChord.bassName` | `FunctionalChord.bass_name` |
| `FunctionalChord.rootName` | `FunctionalChord.root_name` |
| `KeyDetection.shortName` | `KeyDetection.short_name` |
| `chord_functions(key)` | a key mapping takes root and mode only; any other key raises SonareValueError naming it |

#### Progress is an onProgress option, not a separate function

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `analyze_with_progress` | `analyze` |

#### librosa-mirror functions default to librosa's values

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `chirp(linear)` | defaults to False (exponential sweep), as librosa does; pass linear=True for the 1.x sweep |
| `clicks(frequency)` | `clicks(click_freq)` |
| `tone(phase)` | `tone(phi)` |

#### Public tempo searches default to 60-200 BPM

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `analyze_bpm(bpm_max)` | default 300 -> 200, the shared tempo range |
| `analyze_bpm(bpm_min)` | default 30 -> 60, the shared tempo range |
| `plp(tempo_max)` | default 300 -> None, the shared 200 BPM bound |
| `plp(tempo_min)` | default 30 -> None, the shared 60 BPM bound |

#### Errors are coded by cause on every surface

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `analyze_impulse_response(n_octave_bands)` | a bool or a value that is not a number raises TypeError instead of SonareValueError; a negative or non-integer number stays SonareValueError |
| `fix_length(target_size)` | a value that is not a number raises TypeError instead of SonareValueError; a negative or non-integer number stays SonareValueError |
| `pad_center(target_size)` | a value that is not a number raises TypeError instead of SonareValueError; a negative or non-integer number stays SonareValueError |

#### Cheap scalar state reads are getters and properties

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `PolyphonicAnalysis.frame_count` | a property (was a method) |
| `PolyphonicAnalysis.note_count` | a property (was a method) |
| `StreamAnalyzer.available_frames` | a property (was a method) |
| `StreamAnalyzer.frame_count` | a property (was a method) |
| `StreamAnalyzer.sample_rate` | a property (was a method) |

#### Each operation has exactly one entry point

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `StreamAnalyzer.process_with_offset` | removed: call StreamAnalyzer.process(samples, start_sample) |
| `mel_result_to_audio` | removed: call mel_to_audio(result.power, sr=result.sample_rate, n_fft=result.n_fft, hop_length=result.hop_length, fmin=result.fmin_hz, fmax=result.fmax_hz, htk=result.htk) |
| `mel_result_to_stft` | removed: call mel_to_stft(result.power, sr=result.sample_rate, n_fft=result.n_fft, fmin=result.fmin_hz, fmax=result.fmax_hz, htk=result.htk) |
| `metering_phase_scope_decimated` | removed: call metering_phase_scope(..., max_points=n) |
| `metering_vectorscope_decimated` | removed: call metering_vectorscope(..., max_points=n) |
| `mfcc_result_to_audio` | removed: call mfcc_to_audio(result.coefficients, n_mels=result.n_mels, sr=result.sample_rate, n_fft=result.n_fft, hop_length=result.hop_length, fmin=result.fmin_hz, fmax=result.fmax_hz, htk=result.htk) |
| `mfcc_result_to_mel` | removed: call mfcc_to_mel(result.coefficients, n_mels=result.n_mels, lifter=result.lifter) |
| `stft_db` | removed: call stft(..., db=True) and read the result's db plane |

#### Synchronous construction is new X(config); create() is async

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `StreamAnalyzer.constructor(config)` | removed: pass each setting as its own keyword (sample_rate=, n_fft=, hop_length=, ...) |
| `StreamConfig` | removed: pass each setting as its own keyword to StreamAnalyzer: sample_rate= (required), fmin_hz= and fmax_hz= (were fmin/fmax), reference_hz= (was tuning_ref_hz), window= as a WindowType token; compute_magnitude, magnitude_downsample and output_format had no effect and are gone |
| `fourier_tempogram(norm)` | removed: the frames are always normalized, as on every other surface |
| `mfcc_to_audio(mfcc_coeffs)` | `mfcc_to_audio(coefficients)` |
| `mfcc_to_mel(mfcc_coeffs)` | `mfcc_to_mel(coefficients)` |

#### Silence is an infinite level; a measurement that was not taken is absent

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `HumDetection.harmonic_dbfs` | ends before the first harmonic at or past Nyquist instead of reading the dB floor; a harmonic with no energy is -inf |
| `NoiseDetection.band_floor_dbfs` | holds only the bands an analysis bin lands in, so it can be shorter than 32; the new band_floor_band names each entry's band, and an empty band is no longer a sentinel entry |
| `NoiseDetection.floor_dbfs` | float -> float \| None: -inf for digital silence, None when there is nothing to measure from |
| `normalize_stereo` | a silent pair is refused with SonareValueError ('has no measurable level') instead of coming back untouched |

#### Results are typed values, not JSON strings

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `MasteringRepairAnalysis.declipThresholdSafe` | `MasteringRepairAnalysis.declip_threshold_safe` |
| `MasteringRepairAnalysis.integratedLufs` | `MasteringRepairAnalysis.integrated_lufs` |
| `MasteringRepairAnalysis` | a frozen dataclass with snake_case attributes instead of a TypedDict; defects and channels are AudioDefects or None, and recommended holds DeclipStage ... DereverbStage records with the declip level in dBFS |
| `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfig.limiter_enable_isp_limiter` | a bool (was an int read as non-zero); an int, 0 and 1 included, raises TypeError, and RealtimeVoiceChangerConfig.vocoder_enabled is a bool the same way |

| `mastering_repair_decrackle` | returns a frozen DecrackleResult (samples, report) instead of a bare ndarray; read .samples for the audio |

| `mastering_repair_denoise_classical` | returns a frozen DenoiseResult (samples, report) instead of a bare ndarray; read .samples for the audio |
| `mastering_repair_dereverb_classical` | returns a frozen DereverbResult (samples, report) instead of a bare ndarray; read .samples for the audio |
| `mastering_repair_trim_silence` | returns a frozen TrimSilenceResult (samples, report) instead of a bare ndarray; read .samples for the audio |

| `normalize` | returns a float32 ndarray instead of list[float]; a silent take is refused with SonareValueError ('has no measurable level') in both modes |
| `note_move` | returns a float32 ndarray instead of list[float] |
| `note_stretch` | returns a float32 ndarray instead of list[float] |
| `percussive` | returns a float32 ndarray instead of list[float] |

| `spectral_edit` | returns a float32 ndarray instead of list[float] |
| `time_stretch` | returns a float32 ndarray instead of list[float] |
| `trim` | returns a float32 ndarray instead of list[float] |
| `voice_change` | returns a float32 ndarray instead of list[float] |

#### Python composite results are frozen dataclasses

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `NoteObject` | a frozen dataclass; a changed copy comes from dataclasses.replace (the pending edit is still edited in place); every field but edit is required and the bounds are never None, so a hand-made span is a NoteObjectInput and a split_note / merge_notes row a NoteSetEntry |
| `NoteTarget` | a frozen dataclass; a changed copy comes from dataclasses.replace |
| `PercussiveEvent` | a frozen dataclass; a changed copy comes from dataclasses.replace (the pending edit is still edited in place); every field but edit is required and the bounds are never None, so a hand-made span is a PercussiveEventInput |
| `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfig` | a frozen dataclass; a changed copy comes from dataclasses.replace |

#### Python keyword arguments and attributes are snake_case only

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `auto_tune(key)` | a key mapping takes root and mode only; any other key raises SonareValueError naming it |

#### librosa-mirror functions default to librosa's values

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `remix(align_zeros)` | defaults to True (cuts snap to zero crossings), as librosa does; pass align_zeros=False for the 1.x cuts |

#### C counts are size_t and returned through an out parameter

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `StreamingRetune.prepare(sample_rate)` | sample_rate is an integer in Hz; a float, even a whole one, raises SonareValueError |

#### Cheap scalar state reads are getters and properties

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `RealtimeVoiceChanger.config_pod` | `RealtimeVoiceChanger.config`: a read-only property returning the RealtimeVoiceChangerConfig record |
| `RealtimeVoiceChanger.latency_samples` | a property (was a method) |
| `RealtimeVoiceChanger.non_finite_discard_count` | a property (was a method) |
| `StreamingRetune.grain_size` | `StreamingRetune.grain_size_samples`: a property (was a method) |
| `StreamingRetune.latency_samples` | a property (was a method) |

#### Each operation has exactly one entry point

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `NormalizeStereoResult.applied_gain_db` | removed: the C entry no longer reports the gain; compare the input and output levels if it is needed |
| `RealtimeVoiceChanger.process_planar_stereo` | removed: call process_planar([left, right]), which takes 1 or 2 equal-length planes (or a 2-D (channels, frames) array) and returns a list of float32 planes; process_planar_with_carrier(channels, carrier) adds the external vocoder carrier |
| `decompose_with_init` | removed: call decompose(..., init=...) |
| `hpss_with_residual` | removed: call hpss(..., with_residual=True); the residual is HpssResult.residual |
| `normalize_rms_stereo` | removed: call normalize_stereo(left, right, sample_rate, mode="rms", target_db=...); an omitted target_db is -20.0 dBFS in rms mode |
| `normalize_rms` | removed: call normalize(samples, sample_rate, mode="rms", target_db=...); an omitted target_db is -20.0 dBFS in rms mode |
| `pitch_correct_to_midi_timevarying` | removed: call pitch_correct_timevarying(samples, sample_rate, f0_hz, hop_length, target_mode="midi", target_midi=...) |
| `voice_change_realtime(samples)` | `realtime_voice_changer_render(samples)` |

#### Synchronous construction is new X(config); create() is async

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `voice_character_preset_id(preset)` | `voice_character_preset_id(ordinal)` |

#### Channel counts are numChannels

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `RealtimeVoiceChanger.constructor(channels)` | `RealtimeVoiceChanger.constructor(num_channels)` |
| `RealtimeVoiceChanger.process_interleaved(channels)` | `RealtimeVoiceChanger.process_interleaved(num_channels)` |
| `RealtimeVoiceChanger` | num_channels (was channels, default 1) is a required keyword, and an omitted max_block_size takes the library default (was 128); an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError. The preset argument is the keyword config, as the Node and WASM facades name it: a string is a lowerCamel preset id only (JSON text raises SonareValueError, parse it with json.loads), a mapping is a preset document or flat config, a RealtimeVoiceChangerConfig record builds the changer from that config (formant mode included), and any other type is TypeError |
| `voice_change_realtime(channels)` | `realtime_voice_changer_render(num_channels)` |

#### Pass filters are spelled HighPass, LowPass and BandPass

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfig.eq_highpass_hz` | `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfig.eq_high_pass_hz` |

|---|---|

| `StreamingRetune.set_config(semitones)` | `StreamingRetune.set_config(pitch_semitones)` |
| `pitch_shift(semitones)` | `pitch_shift(pitch_semitones)`: renamed to pitch_semitones and required |

#### One type name per record on every surface

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `PitchDecomposition` | `PitchDecompositionResult` |

#### Input-only types are named <Name>Input

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|

| `normalize_stereo(target_db)` | target_db is keyword-only and defaults to None, the default of the new mode keyword ("peak" 0.0 dBFS, "rms" -20.0 dBFS); a target above 0 dBFS or not finite raises SonareValueError |

#### Historical aliases are removed

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|

| `AcousticResult.c80Bands` | removed: read c80_bands |

#### Every JSON document uses camelCase keys

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `RealtimeVoiceChanger.set_config(preset)` | `RealtimeVoiceChanger.set_config(config)`: renamed to config; a string is a preset id only and JSON text raises SonareValueError, a mapping is a document. A flat config document carries harmonySteps (an array of three) instead of harmonyStep1..3, which are refused as unknown fields |

#### Other individual changes

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `DeclipReport.interpolated_runs` | `DeclipReport.unreconstructed_runs`: counts the runs left clipped (past the 512-sample cap, without a usable solve, or reconstructed more than 20 dB above the threshold) instead of runs filled by interpolation; repaired_samples counts only the reconstructed runs |
| `DeclipReport.linked_runs` | 0 unless link_channels=True is passed to a multichannel entry point |
| `PitchDecomposition.centre_hz` | `PitchDecompositionResult.center_hz`: None for a note with no usable pitch (was 0.0) |
| `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfig.from_pod` | removed: the C struct mirror is internal; build the record by keyword, or read RealtimeVoiceChanger.config |
| `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfig.to_pod` | removed: the C struct mirror is internal; pass the record itself as RealtimeVoiceChanger(config=...) |
| `auto_tune(reference_midi)` | `auto_tune(scale_reference_midi)` |
| `auto_tune(strength)` | `auto_tune(retune_amount)` |
| `mastering_repair_declip(lpc_blend)` | removed, no replacement: the declipper no longer blends an interpolation into its LPC fill: a run it cannot reconstruct is left clipped and counted as unreconstructed |
| `mastering_repair_declip_stereo(lpc_blend)` | removed, no replacement: the declipper no longer blends an interpolation into its LPC fill: a run it cannot reconstruct is left clipped and counted as unreconstructed |
| `mastering_repair_declip_stereo` | each channel repairs its own clipped runs by default and leaves every sample it did not clip bit-identical (was always the union of both channels' runs); the new keyword link_channels=True restores the union |
| `mastering_repair_detect_clipping(lpc_blend)` | removed, no replacement: the declipper no longer blends an interpolation into its LPC fill: a run it cannot reconstruct is left clipped and counted as unreconstructed |
| `pitch_correct_timevarying(mode)` | `pitch_correct_timevarying(target_mode)`: renamed to target_mode (PitchTargetMode = 'midi' \| 'scale'); a non-string is a TypeError and an unknown name a SonareValueError |
| `pitch_correct_timevarying(reference_midi)` | `pitch_correct_timevarying(scale_reference_midi)` |
| `scale_correction_semitones(reference_midi)` | `scale_correction_semitones(scale_reference_midi)`: renamed to scale_reference_midi; None is A4 and an explicit 0 is MIDI note 0 (1.x read 0 as A4) |
| `scale_quantize_midi(reference_midi)` | `scale_quantize_midi(scale_reference_midi)`: renamed to scale_reference_midi; None is A4 and an explicit 0 is MIDI note 0 (1.x read 0 as A4) |
| `voice_change_realtime` | `realtime_voice_changer_render`: a preset document must carry schemaVersion 4 (1.x wrote 2) and an earlier one raises SonareError InvalidFormat; dsp.retune.grainSize is renamed grainSizeSamples and is optional (absent = the automatic grain), an explicit 0 raises naming the key, and the old key raises as unknown |

| `metering_true_peak_db(oversample_factor)` | `metering_true_peak_dbtp(oversample_factor)`: None (the default) is 4; an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |

#### An option left out takes the library's default

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|

#### Silence is an infinite level; a measurement that was not taken is absent

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `DynamicRangeReport.dynamic_range_db` | float \| None: `inf` when the low percentile lands on a silent window, None when the high percentile is silent too or the input is empty |

| `DynamicRangeReport.low_percentile_db` | float \| None: `-inf` on a silent window, None for empty input |
| `LoudnessMatch.reference_lufs` | `LoudnessMatchResult.reference_lufs`: a silent or below-gate take is refused with SonareValueError ('has no measurable loudness') instead of reading a non-finite loudness |

| `MasteringAssistantProfile.integratedLufs` | `MasteringAssistantProfile.integrated_lufs`: integratedLufs -> integrated_lufs: -inf for a silent or below-gate take, never None |
| `MasteringAudioProfileLoudness.crestFactorDb` | `MasteringAudioProfileLoudness.crest_factor_db`: crestFactorDb -> crest_factor_db, float \| None: None for a silent take |

| `StreamingMasteringChain.non_finite_discard_count` | a property (was a method) |
| `StreamingMasteringChain.non_finite_substitution_count` | a property (was a method) |

#### Each operation has exactly one entry point

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `mastering_assistant_suggest_chain_stereo` | removed: read mastering_assistant_suggest_stereo(...).chain_config |
| `mastering_assistant_suggest_chain` | removed: read mastering_assistant_suggest(...).chain_config |
| `mastering_chain_stereo` | removed: call master_audio_stereo(left, right, sample_rate, overrides=config) with no preset; overrides={} returns the input |
| `mastering_chain` | removed: call master_audio(samples, sample_rate, overrides=config) with no preset; overrides={} returns the input |

#### masterAudio is the mastering entry; mastering is renamed

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `mastering_pair_process_stereo` | `mastering_apply_pair_processor_stereo` |
| `mastering_pair_process` | `mastering_apply_pair_processor` |
| `mastering_process_stereo` | `mastering_apply_processor_stereo` |
| `mastering_process` | `mastering_apply_processor` |

#### Synchronous construction is new X(config); create() is async

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `StreamingMasteringChain.prepare` | removed: pass sample_rate=, max_block_size= and num_channels= to the constructor |
| `StreamingMasteringChain` | builds and prepares at construction; sample_rate and num_channels are required keywords and an omitted max_block_size takes the library default (an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError); config takes a version 2 chain document's params: a key is a dotted path and nesting is prefix shorthand, enum leaves are tokens; the core reads the content, so a path given twice, a null, a number for a token or a value outside its domain raises SonareError InvalidFormat naming the path; a repair stage that needs the whole signal (declick, declip, decrackle, dehum, dereverb) and the quantile noise estimator raise SonareError NotSupported, not SonareValueError |
| `mastering_insert_param_names(name)` | `mastering_insert_param_names(insert)` |

#### Stereo-only algorithms take left and right

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `MixTrackInput.left` | `MixAssistantTrack.channels`: left/right -> channels, a list or tuple holding one plane for mono or two of equal length for stereo; any other count raises SonareValueError and a bare array raises TypeError |
| `MixTrackInput.right` | `MixAssistantTrack.channels`: left/right -> channels, a list or tuple holding one plane for mono or two of equal length for stereo; any other count raises SonareValueError and a bare array raises TypeError |

#### Channel counts are numChannels

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `WaveformPeaksReport.channels` | `WaveformPeaksReport.num_channels` |
| `lufs_interleaved(channels)` | `lufs_interleaved(num_channels)` |
| `lufs_series_interleaved(channels)` | `lufs_series_interleaved(num_channels)` |
| `waveform_peak_pyramid(channels)` | `waveform_peak_pyramid(num_channels)` |
| `waveform_peaks(channels)` | `waveform_peaks(num_channels)` |

#### Pass filters are spelled HighPass, LowPass and BandPass

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `mastering_dynamics_compressor(sidechain_hpf_enabled)` | removed: give sidechain_high_pass_hz; omitting it leaves the sidechain unfiltered |
| `mastering_dynamics_compressor(sidechain_hpf_hz)` | `mastering_dynamics_compressor(sidechain_high_pass_hz)` |
| `mastering_dynamics_gate(key_hpf_hz)` | `mastering_dynamics_gate(key_high_pass_hz)` |

#### One type name per record on every surface

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `MixTrackInput.track_id` | `MixAssistantTrack.id` |
| `MixTrackInput` | `MixAssistantTrack` |

#### Each list input takes one item form

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `StreamingEqualizer.set_band(band)` | an EqBandInput mapping with camelCase keys only; JSON text raises TypeError, so parse it with json.loads first |
| `master_audio_stereo` | preset, overrides and on_progress are keyword-only; preset defaults to None (was "pop"), which runs overrides as the whole chain (overrides={} returns the input); neither given raises SonareValueError |
| `master_audio` | preset, overrides and on_progress are keyword-only; preset defaults to None (was "pop"), which runs overrides as the whole chain (overrides={} returns the input); neither given raises SonareValueError |

#### Historical aliases are removed

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `mix_source_class_names` | `mixing_assistant_source_class_names`: renamed to the C/JS name |

#### Documents in a 1.x spelling are refused

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `mastering_process(params)` | `mastering_apply_processor(params)`: insert parameter keys are renamed and the old spelling is refused as an unknown key: effects.reverb.room and effects.acoustic.roomMorph maxSeconds -> maxSec; effects.modulation.rotary accelTauS/decelTauS -> accelTauSec/decelTauSec; effects.reverb.velvet reverbTimeS -> reverbTimeSec; dynamics.gate keyHpfHz -> keyHighPassHz; dynamics.deesser bandpassQ -> bandPassQ; voice.changer eqHighpassHz/retuneSemitones/retuneGrainSize -> eqHighPassHz/retunePitchSemitones/retuneGrainSizeSamples; effects.modulation.pitchShifter semitones/semitones2/cents/cents2 -> pitchSemitones/pitchSemitones2/pitchCents/pitchCents2; repair.trimSilence threshold (linear) -> thresholdDb (dBFS, default -60, [-890, 0]); the same keys apply to mastering_insert_timing(params), and dynamics.deesser.bandpassQ -> bandPassQ in master_audio(overrides) and StreamingMasteringChain(config) |

| `MixMeterSnapshot.channel_count` | `MixMeterSnapshot.num_channels` |
| `StreamingMasteringChain.constructor(loudness_static_gain_peak_db)` | `StreamingMasteringChain.constructor(loudness_static_gain_peak_dbtp)` |
| `master_audio(preset_name)` | `master_audio(preset)` |
| `master_audio_stereo(preset_name)` | `master_audio_stereo(preset)` |
| `mastering_insert_param_info(name)` | `mastering_insert_param_info(insert)` |
| `mastering_insert_timing(name)` | `mastering_insert_timing(insert)` |
| `mastering_pair_analyze(analysis_name)` | `mastering_analyze_pair(analysis)` |
| `mastering_pair_process(processor_name)` | `mastering_apply_pair_processor(processor)` |
| `mastering_pair_process_stereo(processor_name)` | `mastering_apply_pair_processor_stereo(processor)` |
| `mastering_process(processor_name)` | `mastering_apply_processor(processor)` |

| `metering_dynamic_range(high_percentile)` | a rank in [0, 1], low at most high; anything else raises SonareValueError |

| `mixing_scene_preset_json(preset_name)` | `mixing_scene_preset(name)` |

### Python: Realtime engine, synthesis, MIDI and playback

#### Sample rate is required wherever samples are passed

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Mixer.from_scene_json(sample_rate)` | `Mixer.from_json(sample_rate)`: required (was 48000 by default) |
| `PlaybackRenderer` | sample_rate is a required keyword (was 48000 by default), and an omitted max_block_size takes the library default (was 1024); an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `RealtimeEngine` | sample_rate is required (was 48000.0 by default); an omitted max_block_size, command_capacity, telemetry_capacity or max_channels takes the library default and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |

#### Physical quantities carry their unit in the name

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `EngineMetronomeConfig.click_seconds` | `EngineMetronomeConfig.click_sec`: float \| None, default None: None selects the library click length and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |

#### A value that is not given is absent, never 0, -1 or ''

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `EngineBounceOptions.dither_seed` | int \| None, default None: None is the built-in dither seed and a given 0 is seed 0 instead of the built-in one |
| `EngineBounceOptions.source_sample_rate` | int \| None, default None: None is the engine's prepared rate and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `EngineBounceOptions.target_lufs` | float \| None, default None: None normalizes to -14 LUFS and a given 0 is a 0 LUFS target instead of the default |
| `EngineBounceOptions.target_sample_rate` | int \| None, default None: None keeps the source rate and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `EngineClip.track_id` | int \| None, default None: None plays the clip on no track lane and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `EngineGraphConnection.dest_node` | a value over 63 UTF-8 bytes raises SonareValueError instead of being cut to fit |
| `EngineGraphConnection.source_node` | a value over 63 UTF-8 bytes raises SonareValueError instead of being cut to fit |
| `EngineGraphNode.id` | a value over 63 UTF-8 bytes raises SonareValueError instead of being cut to fit |
| `EngineGraphNode.num_ports` | int \| None, default None: None takes the spec's num_channels and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `EngineGraphParameterBinding.node_id` | a value over 63 UTF-8 bytes raises SonareValueError instead of being cut to fit |
| `EngineGraphSpec.input_node` | a value over 63 UTF-8 bytes raises SonareValueError instead of being cut to fit, and an empty string raises SonareValueError naming set_graph |
| `EngineGraphSpec.output_node` | a value over 63 UTF-8 bytes raises SonareValueError instead of being cut to fit, and an empty string raises SonareValueError naming set_graph |
| `EngineMarker.name` | defaults to None for an unnamed marker and reads back None (was an empty string); an empty string raises SonareValueError, and a name over 63 UTF-8 bytes raises instead of being cut |
| `EngineMetronomeConfig.click_samples` | int \| None, default None: None derives the length from click_sec, an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError, and metronome() reads an unset length back as None |
| `EngineMidiClipSchedule.id` | int \| None, default None: None leaves the clip unidentified and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `EngineMidiClipSchedule.length_samples` | int \| None, default None: None is open-ended, and 0 or a negative length raises SonareValueError instead of reading as open-ended |
| `EngineMidiClipSchedule.loop_length_samples` | int \| None, default None: None is no loop length; a given length is read only with loop=True, where 0 or a negative length raises SonareValueError |
| `EngineMidiClipSchedule.track_id` | int \| None, default None: None is no track and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError; an omitted destination_id still falls back to it |
| `ExternalMidiEvent.destination_id` | None for a clock/transport byte meant for every external port (was 0xFFFFFFFF) |
| `Mixer.add_strip(true_peak_oversample)` | absent is None (the library default 4x); an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `ParameterInfo.name` | a value over 63 UTF-8 bytes raises SonareValueError instead of being cut to fit |
| `ParameterInfo.unit` | a value over 15 UTF-8 bytes raises SonareValueError instead of being cut to fit |
| `RealtimeEngine.can_set_bus_sidechain(source_id)` | `RealtimeEngine.can_set_bus_sidechain(source)`: the source is one SidechainSource(kind, id) record; source.id 0 raises SonareValueError and anything else raises TypeError |
| `RealtimeEngine.can_set_lane_sidechain(source_track_id)` | `RealtimeEngine.can_set_strip_sidechain(source)`: the source is one SidechainSource('track', id) record; source.id 0 raises SonareValueError and a track strip refuses a source of kind 'bus' with SonareValueError |
| `RealtimeEngine.can_set_master_sidechain(source_id)` | `RealtimeEngine.can_set_strip_sidechain(source)`: the source is one SidechainSource(kind, id) record; source.id 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `RealtimeEngine.prepare(max_block_size)` | optional; omitted takes the library default and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `RealtimeEngine.prime_offline_parameters(block_size)` | optional; omitted takes the library default and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `RealtimeEngine.set_bus_sidechain(source_id)` | `RealtimeEngine.set_bus_sidechain(source)`: the source is one SidechainSource(kind, id) record or None; None removes the binding, source.id 0 raises SonareValueError and anything else raises TypeError |
| `RealtimeEngine.set_lane_sidechain(source_track_id)` | `RealtimeEngine.set_strip_sidechain(source)`: the source is one SidechainSource('track', id) record or None; None removes the binding, source.id 0 raises SonareValueError, and a track strip refuses a source of kind 'bus' with SonareValueError |
| `RealtimeEngine.set_master_sidechain(source_id)` | `RealtimeEngine.set_strip_sidechain(source)`: the source is one SidechainSource(kind, id) record or None; None removes the binding and source.id 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `RealtimeEngine.set_track_output_bus(bus_id)` | None returns the lane to the master mix; bus_id 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `SampleBank.add_sample(source_rate)` | float \| None, default None: None plays at the render's own rate and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `SynthPatch.preset` | None (the default) is the init patch, which an empty string used to mean; an empty name now raises SonareValueError, a name longer than 31 UTF-8 bytes raises instead of being truncated, and a patch read back with no preset has None |

#### An option left out takes the library's default

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `EngineBounceOptions.block_size` | omitted takes the library default (was 128) and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `EngineFreezeOptions.block_size` | omitted takes the library default (was 128) and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `Mixer.from_scene_json(block_size)` | `Mixer.from_json(max_block_size)`: renamed max_block_size after the C parameter; omitted takes the library default (was 512) and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `RealtimeEngine.prepare(command_capacity)` | omitted takes the library default (was 1024) and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `RealtimeEngine.prepare(max_channels)` | omitted takes the library default (was 64) and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `RealtimeEngine.prepare(telemetry_capacity)` | omitted takes the library default (was 1024) and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `RealtimeEngine.render_offline(block_size)` | omitted takes the library default (was 128) and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |

#### Silence is an infinite level; a measurement that was not taken is absent

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `MeterTelemetryRecord.correlation` | float -> float \| None: None on a zero channel or silence |
| `MeterTelemetryRecord.integrated_lufs` | float -> float \| None: None before the first gating block, -inf while nothing passes the gate |
| `MeterTelemetryRecord.max_true_peak_db` | `MeterTelemetryRecord.max_true_peak_dbtp`: max_true_peak_db -> max_true_peak_dbtp, float \| None: -inf for silence, None when not measured |
| `MeterTelemetryRecord.momentary_lufs` | float -> float \| None: -inf for silence, None until the window fills |
| `MeterTelemetryRecord.mono_compat_width` | float -> float \| None: None on a zero channel or silence, inf for a silent mid under a nonzero side |
| `MeterTelemetryRecord.short_term_lufs` | float -> float \| None: -inf for silence, None until the window fills |
| `ScopeTelemetryRecord.bands` | -inf for a band of zero power, NaN for a band no bin reaches and before the first transform |

#### String values are lowerCamelCase tokens

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `RealtimeEngine.bind_controller(axis)` | takes pitchCents / vibratoDepth exactly |
| `RealtimeEngine.bind_controller(input)` | takes the exact lowerCamel controller input token (controlChange, channelPressure, polyPressure, pitchBend) |
| `RealtimeEngine.set_articulation(articulation)` | takes monoRetrigger / monoLegato exactly; the kebab spellings are refused |
| `RealtimeEngine.set_controller_profile(preset_name)` | takes breathAftertouch instead of breath-aftertouch |
| `SidechainCheck.reason` | a lowerCamel SidechainRefusal token (invalidTarget, insertOutOfRange, ...) instead of snake_case |
| `SynthModRouting.destination` | takes the exact lowerCamel mod destination token (pitchCents, cutoffCents, ampGain, ...) |
| `SynthModRouting.source` | takes the exact lowerCamel mod source token (ampEnv, filterEnv, keyTrack, modWheel, expressionCc, pitchBend) |
| `SynthPatch.body` | takes the exact lowerCamel body type token (woodTube, brassBell) |
| `SynthPatch.engine_mode` | takes the exact lowerCamel engine mode token (karplusStrong, pipeOrgan, bowedString, pluckedString, freeReed); kebab and case-folded spellings are refused and an ordinal is TypeError |
| `SynthPatch.filter_model` | takes the exact lowerCamel filter model token (transistorLadder, diodeLadder, sallenKey, svf4Pole); the moog-ladder input spelling is removed |
| `SynthPatch.sample_loop` | takes keyDown instead of key-down |
| `synth_enum_tables` | every NativeSynth enum token is lowerCamel (karplusStrong, transistorLadder, keyDown, monoRetrigger, ...) |
| `synth_preset_names` | lists the NativeSynth presets in lowerCamel (sawLead, ePiano, drumKit, ...) |
| `synth_preset_patch` | accepts only the lowerCamel preset names synth_preset_names lists |

#### Closed sets are string unions, not numbers or IntEnums

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `AutomationPoint.curve_to_next` | an AutomationCurve token, default 'linear'; a number is TypeError |
| `ChannelLayout.FIVE_POINT_ONE` | `ChannelLayout='5.1'` |

#### Errors are coded by cause on every surface

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Mixer.read_goniometer_latest(max_points)` | a bool or a value that is not a number raises TypeError instead of SonareValueError; a negative or non-integer number stays SonareValueError |
| `Mixer.strip_by_id` | an unknown id raises SonareValueError instead of KeyError |
| `Mixer` | a strip reference naming an unknown id or an out-of-range index raises SonareValueError instead of KeyError or IndexError. The constructor takes keywords: Mixer(sample_rate=..., scene=<MixSceneDocument mapping>) builds from a scene, an omitted scene builds an empty mixer, a non-mapping scene raises TypeError (parse JSON text with json.loads or use Mixer.from_json); the handle form is gone |
| `RealtimeEngine.set_midi_fx` | raises SonareValueError (INVALID_PARAMETER) instead of SonareError (INVALID_FORMAT) for a config the library refuses, naming the key under config ('config.velocityGamma must be > 0') |
| `RealtimeEngine.set_part_rig` | raises SonareValueError (INVALID_PARAMETER) instead of SonareError (INVALID_FORMAT) for inserts the library refuses, naming the place under inserts ('inserts must hold 1 to 8 entries for a chain rig'); an insert is forwarded as given, so its annotation keys ($comment, x-*) are accepted and any other unknown key is refused by the library ('unknown key inserts[0].parmas (expected processor, params)'), as is a params key the processor does not read ('unknown key inserts[0].params.drive (expected aliasing, ceiling, driveDb, mix)') |

### Python: Projects, arrangement and vocal editing

#### Sample rate is required wherever samples are passed

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Project.add_loop_recording_takes(audio_channels)` | audio_channels is required for interleaved audio (1.x defaulted to 1); planar audio derives it, and an audio_channels beside planar audio raises SonareValueError |
| `Project.add_loop_recording_takes(audio_sample_rate)` | audio_sample_rate is required (1.x defaulted to 48000); a non-positive rate raises SonareValueError |

#### A value that is not given is absent, never 0, -1 or ''

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `BuiltinSynthConfig.attack_ms` | float \| None, default None: None selects the library value; a given value is read literally and a value outside (0, 20000] (0 included) raises SonareValueError |
| `BuiltinSynthConfig.decay_ms` | float \| None, default None: None selects the library value; a given value is read literally and a value outside (0, 20000] (0 included) raises SonareValueError |
| `BuiltinSynthConfig.gain` | float \| None, default None: None selects the library value; a given value is read literally and a value outside (0, 4] (0 included) raises SonareValueError |
| `BuiltinSynthConfig.polyphony` | int \| None, default None: None selects 16 voices; a given count is read literally and 0 or a count outside [1, 64] raises SonareValueError |
| `BuiltinSynthConfig.release_ms` | float \| None, default None: None selects the library value; a given value is read literally and a value outside (0, 20000] (0 included) raises SonareValueError |
| `BuiltinSynthConfig.sustain` | float \| None, default None: None selects the library value; a given value is read literally and a value outside (0, 1] (0 included) raises SonareValueError |
| `MidiCcBinding.channel` | None for a binding that answers any channel (was 0xFF); 0xFF or anything outside 0..15 raises SonareValueError |
| `Project.add_clip(audio_channels)` | required alongside audio and refused without it (was 1 by default) |
| `Project.add_clip(audio_sample_rate)` | required alongside audio and refused without it (the 0 default is gone) |
| `Project.add_track(name)` | an empty string raises SonareValueError; omit the name or pass None for an unnamed track |
| `Project.apply_vocal_edit(take_id)` | int \| None, default None: None edits the clip's base source and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `Project.bounce(block_size)` | omitted (None) takes the library default; the 0 sentinel default is gone and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `Project.bounce(num_channels)` | omitted (None) takes the library default; the 0 sentinel default is gone and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `Project.bounce(sample_rate)` | omitted (None) takes the library default; the 0 sentinel default is gone and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `Project.bounce(total_frames)` | omitted (None) takes the library default; the 0 sentinel default is gone and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `Project.gm_drum_note_for_name` | an unknown name raises SonareValueError (returned -1); name is a str, None is TypeError |
| `Project.gm_family_first_program` | a family outside 0..15 raises SonareValueError (returned -1) |
| `Project.gm_program_for_name` | an unknown name raises SonareValueError (returned -1); name is a str, None is TypeError |
| `Project.midi_cc_index_for_name` | an unknown name raises SonareValueError (returned -1); name is a str, None is TypeError |
| `Project.midi_route_events(config)` | filter_group, filter_channel and remap_channel are 0..15, absent or None for any / no remap; -1 and any other value outside 0..15 raise SonareValueError naming the key |
| `Project.move_clip(new_track_id)` | int \| None, default None: None keeps the clip on its track and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `Project.set_audio_source_metadata(content_hash)` | None clears the field; an empty string raises SonareValueError |
| `Project.set_audio_source_metadata(external_stem_role)` | None clears the field; an empty string raises SonareValueError |
| `Project.set_clip_loop(loop_length_ppq)` | float \| None, default None: omitted loops the whole clip; an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError (it was the whole-clip sentinel) and a negative length is refused |
| `Project.set_clip_takes(active_take_id)` | int \| None, default None: None plays the clip's base source and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `Project.set_marker(marker_id)` | set_marker(ppq, *, marker_id=None, name=None, kind=None, key_fifths=None, key_minor=None): ppq first, the rest keyword-only; an omitted marker_id allocates and an explicit 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `Project.set_marker(name)` | None leaves the marker unnamed; an empty string raises SonareValueError |
| `Project.set_warp_map(name)` | None leaves the map unnamed; an empty string raises SonareValueError |
| `Project.transcribe_to_clip(reattack_ratio)` | None means no split; an explicit 0, a negative value or a value up to 1 raises SonareValueError |
| `ProjectClip.loop_length_ppq` | float \| None: None when the clip loops its whole length (was 0.0) |
| `ProjectMarker.name` | None for an unnamed marker (was an empty string) |
| `ProjectSource.content_hash` | None when unset (was an empty string) |
| `ProjectSource.external_stem_role` | None when unset (was an empty string) |
| `ProjectSource.name_or_uri` | a MIDI source name or audio URI longer than 127 bytes reads back whole instead of cut |
| `ProjectTrack.name` | str \| None: None for an unnamed track (1.x read ""), and a name longer than 63 bytes reads back whole instead of cut |
| `ProjectVocalEditApplyResult.take_id` | int \| None: None when the edit belongs to the clip's base source (was 0) |
| `ProjectVocalEditDependency.take_id` | int \| None: None when the edit belongs to the clip's base source (was 0) |
| `ProjectVocalRehydrateItem.take_id` | int \| None: None when the edit belongs to the clip's base source (was 0) |
| `Sf2InstrumentConfig.gain` | float \| None, default None: None selects the library value (0.5); a given value is read literally, so 0 is silence and a value outside [0, 4] raises SonareValueError |
| `Sf2InstrumentConfig.polyphony` | int \| None, default None: None selects 48 voices; a given count is read literally and 0 or a count outside [1, 64] raises SonareValueError |
| `VocalNote.center_midi` | None on an unpitched note (was 0.0) |
| `VocalNote.f0_stability` | None on an unpitched note (was 0.0) |
| `VocalNote.has_pitch` | removed: the pitch fields are None on an unpitched note |
| `VocalNote.median_hz` | None on an unpitched note (was 0.0) |
| `align_take_to_reference(bins_per_octave)` | an explicit 0 (or any value below 1) raises SonareValueError instead of being read as the library value; omit it or pass None for that |
| `align_take_to_reference(hop_length)` | an explicit 0 (or any value below 1) raises SonareValueError instead of being read as the library value; omit it or pass None for that |
| `chord_symbol_from_analysis` | omits slash_bass_pc when the chord has no slash bass (was 255), and quality is a ProjectChordQuality token ('unknown', 'major', 'minor', 'diminished', 'augmented', 'dominant', 'halfDiminished', 'suspended') instead of an ordinal |

#### Every call scans its input for non-finite values

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `align_take_to_reference(validate)` | removed: every call scans its input for NaN and infinity and refuses one with SonareValueError naming the argument and index, and validate= raises TypeError |

#### Closed sets are string unions, not numbers or IntEnums

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `BuiltinSynthConfig.waveform` | takes a SynthWaveform token ('sine' default); the SYNTH_WAVEFORM_* ordinals are removed and a number is TypeError |
| `MidiCcBinding.kind` | a ProjectMidiCcBindingKind token ('controlChange7', 'controlChange14', 'rpn', 'nrpn') instead of an ordinal; a number is TypeError and another spelling raises SonareValueError |
| `Project.add_automation_lane(target_kind)` | takes a ProjectAutomationTargetKind token ('opaque', 'trackFaderDb', 'trackPan'); 'track-fader-db' and 'track-pan' raise SonareValueError, a number is TypeError, and the AUTOMATION_TARGET_* ordinals are removed |
| `Project.add_track(kind)` | takes a ProjectTrackKind token ('audio' default, 'midi', 'aux'); the TRACK_AUDIO / TRACK_MIDI / TRACK_AUX ordinals are removed and a number is TypeError |
| `Project.edit_automation_lane(target_kind)` | takes a ProjectAutomationTargetKind token ('opaque', 'trackFaderDb', 'trackPan'); 'track-fader-db' and 'track-pan' raise SonareValueError and a number is TypeError |
| `Project.set_clip_fade(fade_in_curve)` | a ProjectFadeCurve token only (linear, equalPower, exponential, logarithmic); separator variants and abbreviations raise, the FADE_CURVE_* ordinals are removed and a number is TypeError |
| `Project.set_clip_fade(fade_out_curve)` | a ProjectFadeCurve token only (linear, equalPower, exponential, logarithmic); separator variants and abbreviations raise, the FADE_CURVE_* ordinals are removed and a number is TypeError |
| `Project.set_clip_loop(loop_mode)` | 'off' or 'loop' only; 'on', 'none' and the LOOP_MODE_* ordinals are refused |
| `Project.set_clip_warp_mode(mode)` | takes a ProjectWarpMode token ('off', 'repitch', 'tempoSync', 'timeStretch'); 'tempo-sync' and 'time-stretch' raise SonareValueError and a number is TypeError |
| `Project.set_overlap_policy(policy)` | takes "disallow" or "allow"; an integer raises TypeError |
| `Project.set_part_rig` | mode takes a PartRigMode token; an ordinal is TypeError; raises SonareValueError (INVALID_PARAMETER) instead of SonareError (INVALID_FORMAT) for inserts the library refuses, naming the place under inserts ('inserts must hold 1 to 8 entries for a chain rig'); an insert is forwarded as given, so its annotation keys ($comment, x-*) are accepted and any other unknown key is refused by the library ('unknown key inserts[0].parmas (expected processor, params)'), as is a params key the processor does not read ('unknown key inserts[0].params.drive (expected aliasing, ceiling, driveDb, mix)') |
| `Project.set_track_kind(kind)` | takes a ProjectTrackKind token ('audio', 'midi', 'aux'); a number is TypeError |
| `ProjectClip.loop_mode` | a ProjectLoopMode token ('off', 'loop') instead of an ordinal |
| `ProjectClip.source_kind` | a ProjectSourceKind token ('audio', 'midi') instead of an ordinal |
| `ProjectMarker.kind` | a MarkerKind token, default 'marker'; an ordinal is TypeError |
| `ProjectSource.kind` | a ProjectSourceKind token ('audio', 'midi') instead of an ordinal |
| `ProjectTrack.kind` | a ProjectTrackKind token ('audio', 'midi', 'aux') instead of an ordinal |

| `ProjectVocalReason.CANCELLED` | `VocalReason='cancelled'` |

| `ProjectVocalReason.INVALID_STATE` | `VocalReason='invalidState'` |

| `ProjectVocalReason.SOURCE_MISMATCH` | `VocalReason='sourceMismatch'` |
| `ProjectVocalReason.UNSUPPORTED` | `VocalReason='unsupported'` |
| `ProjectVocalReason` | `VocalReason` |
| `ProjectVocalRehydrateItem.reason` | a VocalReason token instead of a number or IntEnum |
| `ProjectVocalRehydrateItem.status` | a ProjectVocalRehydrateStatus token instead of a number or IntEnum |
| `ProjectVocalRehydrateStatus.ALREADY_READY` | `ProjectVocalRehydrateStatus='alreadyReady'` |

| `Sf2ProgramStatus.backend` | a SourceBackend token ('synth' or 'sf2') instead of an ordinal |
| `VocalEditError.reason` | a VocalReason token instead of a number |
