|---|---|
| `Project.set_source_audio(channels)` | `Project.set_source_audio(num_channels)` |

#### Frequency bounds are f0MinHz/f0MaxHz and fminHz/fmaxHz

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Project.transcribe_to_clip(fmax)` | `Project.transcribe_to_clip(f0_max_hz)` |
| `Project.transcribe_to_clip(fmin)` | `Project.transcribe_to_clip(f0_min_hz)` |

#### Input-only types are named <Name>Input

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Project.set_marker_ex` | removed: project.set_marker(ppq, marker_id=..., name=..., kind=..., key_fifths=..., key_minor=...) |

#### Each list input takes one item form

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Project.add_automation_lane(target_param_id)` | takes the target id, points and target_kind as arguments (a descriptor mapping is refused) and each point is an AutomationPoint, as RealtimeEngine.set_automation_lane takes; a tuple or a mapping is TypeError, and target_kind=None selects the untyped lane |
| `Project.annotate_keys(keys)` | each key is a mapping with start_ppq, end_ppq, optional tonic_pc and optional mode (a tuple is TypeError); mode is a ProjectKeyMode token ('unknown', 'major', 'minor', 'dorian', 'phrygian', 'lydian', 'mixolydian', 'locrian') instead of an ordinal, and absent or None is 'unknown'; an unknown tonic_pc is absent or None, and 255 or any value outside 0..11 raises SonareValueError naming the field |
| `Project.bake_midi_fx(config_json)` | `Project.bake_midi_fx(config)`: a MidiFxConfig mapping with camelCase keys (transposeSemitones, velocityScale, quantizePpq, chordIntervals, ...) instead of JSON text; JSON text raises TypeError, so parse it with json.loads first, and an earlier snake_case key or an unknown key raises SonareError InvalidFormat naming it |
| `Project.edit_automation_lane(target_param_id)` | takes the target id, points and target_kind as arguments (a descriptor mapping is refused) and each point is an AutomationPoint, as RealtimeEngine.set_automation_lane takes; a tuple or a mapping is TypeError, and target_kind=None keeps the lane's kind |
| `Project.midi_cc_learn(events)` | each event is a ProjectMidiEvent record; a tuple or mapping is TypeError |
| `Project.midi_cc_to_breakpoint(bindings)` | each binding is a MidiCcBinding record; a mapping is TypeError |
| `Project.midi_cc_to_breakpoint(event)` | a ProjectMidiEvent record; a tuple or mapping is TypeError |
| `Project.midi_param_to_cc(bindings)` | each binding is a MidiCcBinding record; a mapping is TypeError |
| `Project.midi_route_events(events)` | each event is a ProjectMidiEvent record; a tuple or mapping is TypeError |
| `Project.preview_midi_fx_count(config_json)` | `Project.preview_midi_fx_count(config)`: a MidiFxConfig mapping with camelCase keys (transposeSemitones, velocityScale, quantizePpq, chordIntervals, ...) instead of JSON text; JSON text raises TypeError, so parse it with json.loads first, and an earlier snake_case key or an unknown key raises SonareError InvalidFormat naming it |
| `Project.set_assist_sidecar(module_id)` | takes module_id and payload positionally and schema_version, target_track_id, region_start_ppq and region_end_ppq as keywords; a descriptor mapping in place of module_id is TypeError |
| `Project.set_clip_comp_segments(segments)` | each segment is a mapping (a 3- or 4-tuple is TypeError) taking start_ppq, end_ppq, take_id and crossfade_ppq only; startPpq, endPpq, takeId and crossfadePpq raise SonareValueError naming the key; segments is required and None raises TypeError, pass [] to clear; a take_id absent or None plays the base/active take and 0 raises SonareValueError |
| `Project.set_clip_takes(takes)` | each take is a mapping (a tuple is TypeError) taking id, source_id, source_offset_ppq and name only; sourceId and sourceOffsetPpq raise SonareValueError naming the key; takes is required and None raises TypeError, pass [] to clear; id is required and non-zero, a source_id absent or None uses the clip's source and 0 raises SonareValueError, a name absent or None leaves the take unnamed, an empty name raises SonareValueError and a non-string name raises TypeError instead of being converted with str() |
| `Project.set_midi_events(events)` | each event is a ProjectMidiEvent record, or the whole list is one (n, 3) array of ppq, word0, word1 columns; a tuple or mapping is TypeError |
| `Project.set_tempo_segments(segments)` | each segment is a mapping (a tuple is TypeError) taking start_ppq, bpm and end_bpm only; start_sample, which was ignored, and any other key raise SonareValueError naming it |
| `Project.set_time_signatures(segments)` | each segment is a mapping (a tuple is TypeError) taking start_ppq, numerator and denominator only; any other key raises SonareValueError naming it instead of being ignored |

## Node

The Node addon and the WASM package share one vocabulary, so a name in this section has the same 2.0.0 spelling in the WASM section. Closed sets are string unions, an option left out is absent, results are typed values rather than JSON strings, and a refused argument is a `TypeError` or `RangeError`.

### Node: Loading, versions, audio buffers and errors

#### Sample rate is required wherever samples are passed

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.fromBuffer(sampleRate)` | required: the rate of the caller's samples has no default (was 48000) |

#### Sample rate is spelled sampleRate, sample_rate and --sample-rate

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.resample(targetSr)` | `Audio.resample(targetSampleRate)` |
| `Audio.timeStretch(rate)` | removed: pass it as speedRatio in TimeStretchRequest |
| `Audio.timeStretch` | timeStretch(options: Omit<TimeStretchRequest,'samples'\|'sampleRate'>) |

#### Seconds are spelled Sec and _sec

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.getDuration` | `Audio.durationSec` |

#### Physical quantities carry their unit in the name

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.ebur128LoudnessRange` | `Audio.ebur128LoudnessRangeLu` |
| `Audio.spectrumFrame(frameOffset)` | `Audio.spectrumFrame(startSample)` |
| `Audio.truePeakDb` | `Audio.truePeakDbtp` |

#### A value that is not given is absent, never 0, -1 or ''

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.truePeakDb(oversampleFactor)` | `Audio.truePeakDbtp(oversampleFactor)`: optional; omitted is 4, and 0 is refused by name instead of meaning the default |
| `CapabilityCatalogChainList.processor` | T \| null -> optional: a value the result cannot give is an absent field, never null |
| `CapabilityCatalogChainStage.processor` | T \| null -> optional: a value the result cannot give is an absent field, never null |
| `projectAbiVersion` | returns undefined instead of 0 when the feature is compiled out |
| `vocalEditApiVersion` | `vocalEditAbiVersion`: returns undefined instead of 0 when the feature is compiled out |

#### Every call scans its input for non-finite values

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.lufs(options)` | removed: the options bag held only validate, and the call always scans its samples for NaN and infinity |
| `Audio.momentaryLufs(options)` | removed: the options bag held only validate, and the call always scans its samples for NaN and infinity |
| `Audio.shortTermLufs(options)` | removed: the options bag held only validate, and the call always scans its samples for NaN and infinity |
| `ValidateOptions` | removed: no call takes a validate option, and every call scans its input for NaN and infinity |

#### String values are lowerCamelCase tokens

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `EqBandInput.coeffMode` | type EqCoeffMode (core-owned); tokens 'rbj','vicanek' |
| `EqBandInput.phase` | type EqBandPhase (core-owned); tokens 'inherit','zeroLatency','naturalPhase','linearPhase' |
| `EqBandInput.type` | type EqBandType (core-owned union); tokens lowerCamel: 'peak','lowShelf','highShelf','lowPass','highPass','bandPass','notch','allPass','tiltShelf','flatTilt' |
| `EqBandInput` | closed-set fields take the core EqBandType / EqCoeffMode / EqBandPhase unions (lowerCamel tokens); lookaheadMs removed |
| `VoicePresetId='bright-idol'` | `VoicePresetId='brightIdol'` |
| `VoicePresetId='dark-villain'` | `VoicePresetId='darkVillain'` |
| `VoicePresetId='deep-narrator'` | `VoicePresetId='deepNarrator'` |
| `VoicePresetId='neutral-monitor'` | `VoicePresetId='neutralMonitor'` |
| `VoicePresetId='robot-mascot'` | `VoicePresetId='robotMascot'` |
| `VoicePresetId='soft-whisper'` | `VoicePresetId='softWhisper'` |

#### Closed sets are string unions, not numbers or IntEnums

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `ErrorCode` | ErrorCode is a const object plus same-named union type instead of a TS enum; there is no reverse mapping, and StaleResult = 11 is added |

#### Onset strength has one name on every surface

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|

| `Audio.detectBpm` | searches 60-200 BPM by default (was 30-300); bpmMin/bpmMax narrow it |
| `Audio.detectDownbeats` | the beat grid under it searches 60-200 BPM (was 30-300) |

#### Errors are coded by cause on every surface

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `SonareError.cause` | cause is passed through to Error |
| `SonareError.codeName` | typed as the ErrorCodeName union instead of string, and derived from code |
| `SonareError.code` | typed as the ErrorCode union instead of number |

#### Cheap scalar state reads are getters and properties

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.getData` | `Audio.data`: data is one shared Float32Array read on every access; do not mutate it, copy with slice() first |
| `Audio.getLength` | `Audio.length` |
| `Audio.getSampleRate` | `Audio.sampleRate` |

#### Each operation has exactly one entry point

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.fromFileChannel` | removed: Call Audio.fromFile(path, channelIndex). |
| `Audio.masteringChain` | removed: Call masterAudio({ preset, overrides }); the old config is now overrides. |
| `Audio.stftDb` | removed: Call audio.stft({ db: true }); the result then also carries db. |

#### masterAudio is the mastering entry; mastering is renamed

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.masteringProcess` | `Audio.masteringApplyProcessor`: renamed to masteringApplyProcessor<P extends SoloProcessor>(options: OptionsOf<MasteringApplyProcessorRequest<P>>): MasteringResult |
| `Audio.mastering` | `Audio.masteringNormalizeLoudness`: renamed to masteringNormalizeLoudness(options?: MasteringNormalizeLoudnessOptions): MasteringNormalizeLoudnessResult |

#### Synchronous construction is new X(config); create() is async

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio` | new Audio(...) is a TypeError naming the factories: build one with Audio.fromBuffer or another factory |

#### Channel counts are numChannels

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.fileChannelCount(path)` | `Audio.fileNumChannels(path)` |
| `Audio.fileChannelCount` | `Audio.fileNumChannels` |

#### Setters take labelled objects, not positional booleans

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.masterAudio(onProgress)` | removed: pass onProgress as a field of MasterAudioRequest |
| `Audio.masterAudio(overrides)` | removed: pass overrides as a field of MasterAudioRequest |
| `Audio.masterAudio(preset)` | removed: pass preset as a field of MasterAudioRequest |
| `Audio.masterAudio` | masterAudio(options: OptionsOf<MasterAudioRequest>): MasteringChainResult; options must give preset or overrides |
| `Audio.melSpectrogram(htk)` | removed: pass htk as a field of MelSpectrogramRequest |
| `Audio.mfcc(htk)` | removed: pass htk as a field of MfccRequest |
| `Audio.pitchPyin(fillNa)` | removed: pass fillNa as a field of PitchPyinRequest |
| `Audio.pitchYin(fillNa)` | removed: had no effect: YIN reads no fill flag, so PitchYinRequest has no fillNa (pitchPyin keeps it) |

#### Pitch and formant shifts are named in semitones

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.pitchShift(semitones)` | removed: pass it as pitchSemitones in PitchShiftRequest |
| `Audio.pitchShift` | pitchShift(options: Omit<PitchShiftRequest,'samples'\|'sampleRate'>) |

#### Historical aliases are removed

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `CapabilityCatalogChain.aliases` | removed: the catalog lists no other chain spellings; every chain key has exactly one |
| `CapabilityCatalogChainAlias` | removed: the catalog lists no other chain spellings; every chain key has exactly one |
| `EqBandInput.lookaheadMs` | removed: use detectorDelayMs |
| `hasFfmpegSupport` | removed: read capabilities().features.ffmpeg |
| `vocalEditAvailable` | removed: read capabilities().features.vocalEdit |

#### Versions and features come from *AbiVersion() and capabilities()

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `EXPECTED_ABI_VERSION` | removed: no longer exported; the binding checks ABI compatibility at load and throws AbiMismatch, and capabilities().abi reports the loaded versions |
| `EXPECTED_ENGINE_ABI_VERSION` | removed: no longer exported; the binding checks ABI compatibility at load and throws AbiMismatch, and capabilities().abi reports the loaded versions |

#### Other individual changes

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.detectClipping` | delegates to meteringDetectClipping: an unknown option key is a TypeError naming meteringDetectClipping, where the method used to read past it |
| `Audio.dynamicRange` | delegates to meteringDynamicRange: an unknown option key is a TypeError naming meteringDynamicRange, where the method used to read past it |
| `Audio.spectrumFrame` | delegates to meteringSpectrumFrame: an unknown option key is a TypeError naming meteringSpectrumFrame; an explicit nFft of 0 is a RangeError, where the method used to read past it |
| `Audio.spectrum` | delegates to meteringSpectrum: an unknown option key is a TypeError naming meteringSpectrum; an explicit nFft of 0 is a RangeError, where the method used to read past it |

#### An option left out takes the library's default

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `EstimateMeterRequest.compoundSubdivisionThreshold` | the threshold is read on a new scale, the mean accent between the beats as a fraction of the mean accent on them with only a midpoint holding an attack contributing, and its default moves from 0.85 to 0.5, the one calibrated point between the scales; a value set explicitly has to be chosen again on the new scale, not converted by formula |
| `GriffinLimRequest.hopLength` | an omitted hopLength runs as nFft / 4, rounded down and at least 1 (was a fixed 512), so a call with nFft above 2048 and no hopLength changes output with no error: pass hopLength: 512 for the 1.x result; nFft below 1024 no longer fails for want of a hop |
| `MelToAudioRequest.hopLength` | an omitted hopLength runs as nFft / 4, rounded down and at least 1 (was a fixed 512), so a call with nFft above 2048 and no hopLength changes output with no error: pass hopLength: 512 for the 1.x result; nFft below 1024 no longer fails for want of a hop |
| `MfccToAudioRequest.hopLength` | an omitted hopLength runs as nFft / 4, rounded down and at least 1 (was a fixed 512), so a call with nFft above 2048 and no hopLength changes output with no error: pass hopLength: 512 for the 1.x result; nFft below 1024 no longer fails for want of a hop |

#### Silence is an infinite level; a measurement that was not taken is absent

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `AnalysisDynamics.peakDb` | optional: `-Infinity` for silence, absent when not measured |
| `AnalysisDynamics.rmsDb` | optional: `-Infinity` for silence, absent when not measured |
| `SilenceCommonReport.silenceCeilingDb` | optional: a signal with no peak constrains nothing (was 0 for the whole report); Infinity when every signal that has a level holds an exactly zero frame (was 120); absent when every signal is silent |

#### Progress is an onProgress option, not a separate function

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `AnalyzeWithProgressRequest` | removed: use AnalyzeRequest, which carries onProgress |
| `analyzeWithProgress` | removed: call analyze with onProgress in the request, for example analyze({ samples, sampleRate, onProgress }) |
| `analyze` | request gains onProgress?: (progress, stage) => void and cancel?: () => boolean; sampleRate is required (1.x defaulted to 22050) |

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `ChirpRequest.linear` | default false (exponential sweep), was true |

| `stftDb` | removed: Call stft({ samples, sampleRate, db: true }); the result then also carries db. |

#### Historical aliases are removed

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `AnalysisProgressCallback` | removed: use ProgressCallback |
| `DetectKeyOptions` | removed: use KeyDetectionOptions on wasm and DetectKeyRequest on node |
| `DynamicsAnalysisResult` | removed: use DynamicsResult |
| `MelSpectrogramResult.isDb` | removed: it was always false for a forward transform, so read power as linear power and db as the dB form |

| `ScaleName` | removed: use KeyMode |
| `StreamAnalyzer.readFramesSoa` | removed: call readFrames, which returns StreamFrames with band-major Matrix2D mel and chroma |

| `StreamAnalyzerConfig.magnitudeDownsample` | removed: the analyzer emits no magnitude spectrum, so the factor never took effect; drop it from the config |
| `StreamAnalyzerConfig.outputFormat` | removed: it never took effect, so drop it from the config and read frames with readFrames |

#### Other individual changes

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `BpmHypothesis.value` | `AnalysisBpmCandidate.bpm` |
| `CqtRequest.hopLength` | hopLength must be an integer in [1, 65536], the largest hop the transform's FFT length can serve (any positive hop was accepted and then failed or over-allocated); also refused with RangeError: a top bin at or above Nyquist (fminHz * 2^((nBins - 1) / binsPerOctave) must be less than sampleRate / 2) and a filter longer than 131072 samples (naming fminHz, binsPerOctave and filterScale; vqt adds gamma); PseudoCqtRequest, HybridCqtRequest and VqtRequest inherit it |
| `CqtToAudioRequest.hopLength` | hopLength must be an integer in [1, 65536], the largest hop the transform's FFT length can serve (any positive hop was accepted and then failed or over-allocated) |
| `FunctionalChord.roman` | `FunctionalChord.romanNumeral` |
| `GriffinLimRequest.nFft` | omitted, inferred from the magnitude's bin count as (rows - 1) * 2 (was a 2048 default); a size that disagrees with the bin count is a RangeError |
| `NoteSegmentsConfig` | removed: put segmentationThresholdCents, minNoteMs, referenceHz and voicedThreshold directly on NoteSegmentsRequest |
| `NoteSegmentsRequest.config` | removed: put segmentationThresholdCents, minNoteMs, referenceHz and voicedThreshold directly on the request |
| `NoteSegmentsRequest.voicedProb` | optional; give voiced?: VoicedFlags (pitchPyin voicedFlag) or a real probability; one of the two required, voiced wins |
| `OnsetStrengthMultiRequest.fmax` | removed: drop the key; onsetStrengthMulti never read it, and it is now refused as unknown (TypeError) |
| `OnsetStrengthMultiRequest.fmin` | removed: drop the key; onsetStrengthMulti never read it, and it is now refused as unknown (TypeError) |
| `OnsetStrengthMultiRequest.htk` | removed: drop the key; onsetStrengthMulti never read it, and it is now refused as unknown (TypeError) |
| `PcenOptions` | removed: put timeConstant, gain, bias, power and eps on PcenRequest |
| `VqtToAudioRequest.hopLength` | hopLength must be an integer in [1, 65536], the largest hop the transform's FFT length can serve (any positive hop was accepted and then failed or over-allocated) |
| `fourierTempogram` | norm option removed |
| `framesToSamples(hopLength)` | a hop of 0 or a negative is refused with RangeError ('hopLength must be an integer in [1, 2147483647]') like the other frame conversions; 1.x computed with it and returned 0 frames or a negative sample index |
| `noteSegments` | request gains voiced?: VoicedFlags (wins over voicedProb); voicedProb optional; nested config removed |
| `samplesToFrames(hopLength)` | a hop of 0 or a negative is refused with RangeError ('hopLength must be an integer in [1, 2147483647]') like the other frame conversions; 1.x computed with it and returned 0 frames or a negative sample index |

| `RoomMorphOptions.maxSeconds` | `RoomMorphOptions.maxSec` |
| `RoomMorphRequest.maxSeconds` | `RoomMorphRequest.maxSec` |
| `RoomMorphStereoRequest.maxSeconds` | `RoomMorphStereoRequest.maxSec` |

#### Physical quantities carry their unit in the name

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `DeclipOptions.clipThreshold` | `DeclipOptions.clipThresholdDb`: clipThreshold -> clipThresholdDb (linear clip level -> dBFS; default 20*log10(0.98) ~ -0.175 dBFS) |
| `MasteringRepairDeclipRequest.clipThreshold` | `MasteringRepairDeclipRequest.clipThresholdDb`: clipThreshold -> clipThresholdDb |
| `MasteringRepairDeclipStereoRequest.clipThreshold` | removed: give clipThresholdDb, in dBFS at or below 0 (20*log10 of the old linear amplitude) |
| `MasteringRepairDetectClippingRequest.clipThreshold` | removed: give clipThresholdDb, in dBFS at or below 0 (20*log10 of the old linear amplitude) |
| `MasteringRepairDetectTrimRangeRequest.threshold` | removed: give thresholdDb, in dBFS (20*log10 of the old linear amplitude) |
| `MasteringRepairDetectTrimRangeStereoRequest.threshold` | removed: give thresholdDb, in dBFS (20*log10 of the old linear amplitude) |
| `MasteringRepairTrimSilenceRequest.threshold` | `MasteringRepairTrimSilenceRequest.thresholdDb`: threshold -> thresholdDb |
| `MasteringRepairTrimSilenceStereoRequest.threshold` | removed: give thresholdDb, in dBFS (20*log10 of the old linear amplitude) |
| `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfig.retuneGrainSize` | `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfig.retuneGrainSizeSamples`: retuneGrainSize -> retuneGrainSizeSamples (a multiple of 4 in [4, 8192]; absent = the automatic grain; 0 and any other value outside the domain -> RangeError, never rounded or clamped) |
| `masteringRepairAnalyze` | the recommended stages carry no linear clipThreshold (the declip threshold is clipThresholdDb, in dBFS), and masteringRepairApply takes them as they stand |

#### A value that is not given is absent, never 0, -1 or ''

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `NnFilterRequest.k` | 0 or a negative k is refused with RangeError; it used to filter with 5 neighbours (capped at the frame count). Omit k for the default 7 |
| `RealtimeVoiceChangerOptions.maxBlockSize` | the 1.x default value is gone: omit it for the library default; an explicit 0 is refused |
| `RirSynthOptions.crossfadeMs` | `SynthesizeRirRequest.crossfadeMs`: absent = 5 ms; an explicit 0 is a 0 ms crossfade (hard switch), where 1.x read 0 as the default |
| `RirSynthOptions.mixingTimeMs` | `SynthesizeRirRequest.mixingTimeMs`: absent = library default; explicit 0 -> RangeError ("omit for the default") |
| `RoomEstimateOptions.aspectHintLh` | absent = library default; explicit 0 -> RangeError ("omit for the default") |
| `RoomEstimateOptions.aspectHintLw` | absent = library default; explicit 0 -> RangeError ("omit for the default") |
| `RoomEstimateOptions.minDecayDb` | absent = library default; explicit 0 -> RangeError ("omit for the default") |
| `RoomEstimateOptions.nOctaveBands` | absent = library default; explicit 0 -> RangeError ("omit for the default") |
| `RoomEstimateOptions.noiseFloorMarginDb` | absent = library default; explicit 0 -> RangeError ("omit for the default") |
| `RoomEstimateOptions.referenceAbsorption` | absent = library default; explicit 0 -> RangeError ("omit for the default") |
| `RoomGeometryOptions.airHumidityPercent` | `RoomGeometry.airHumidityPercent`: absent = 50 %RH; an explicit 0 is 0 %RH, where 1.x read 0 as the default climate |
| `RoomGeometryOptions.airTemperatureC` | `RoomGeometry.airTemperatureC`: absent = 20 degC; an explicit 0 is 0 degC, where 1.x read 0 as the default climate |
| `RoomGeometryOptions.seed` | `RoomGeometry.seed`: absent = seed 1; an explicit 0 is a seed of its own, where 1.x read 0 as the default seed |
| `RoomMorphOptions.crossfadeMs` | absent = 5 ms; an explicit 0 is a 0 ms crossfade (hard switch), where 1.x read 0 as the default |
| `RoomMorphOptions.mixingTimeMs` | absent = library default; explicit 0 -> RangeError ("omit for the default") |
| `SpectralEditOptions.healRadiusFrames` | an explicit 0 is refused with RangeError; omit healRadiusFrames for the default (0 used to select it) |
| `SpectralEditOptions.hopLength` | an explicit 0 is refused with RangeError; omit hopLength for the default (0 used to select it) |
| `SpectralEditOptions.nFft` | an explicit 0 is refused with RangeError; omit nFft for the default (0 used to select it) |
| `SpectralRegionOp.highHz` | 0, a negative or a non-finite high edge is refused with RangeError; omit highHz for Nyquist (0 or a negative used to select it) |
| `StreamingRetune.config` | returns StreamingRetuneAppliedConfig { pitchSemitones, mix, grainSizeSamples? }: grainSizeSamples is the grain as configured, absent when automatic (was the grain in use); the grain in use is the grainSizeSamples getter, and setConfig(config()) round-trips |
| `StreamingRetuneConfig.grainSize` | `StreamingRetuneConfig.grainSizeSamples`: grainSize -> grainSizeSamples (grain size in samples, a multiple of 4 in [4, 8192]; absent = the automatic grain derived from the sample rate; 0 and any other value outside the domain -> RangeError, never rounded or clamped) |
| `scaleCorrectionSemitones(referenceMidi)` | `scaleCorrectionSemitones(scaleReferenceMidi)`: scaleCorrectionSemitones(scaleReferenceMidi?): absent is A4 and an explicit 0 is MIDI note 0 |
| `scaleQuantizeMidi(referenceMidi)` | `scaleQuantizeMidi(scaleReferenceMidi)`: scaleQuantizeMidi(scaleReferenceMidi?): absent is A4 and an explicit 0 is MIDI note 0 |

#### An option left out takes the library's default

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `HpssRequest.hopLength` | an omitted hopLength runs as nFft / 4, rounded down and at least 1 (was a fixed 512), so a call with nFft above 2048 and no hopLength changes output with no error: pass hopLength: 512 for the 1.x result; nFft below 1024 no longer fails for want of a hop |
| `PitchShiftRequest.hopLength` | an omitted hopLength runs as nFft / 4, rounded down and at least 1 (was a fixed 512), so a call with nFft above 2048 and no hopLength changes output with no error: pass hopLength: 512 for the 1.x result; nFft below 1024 no longer fails for want of a hop |
| `TimeStretchRequest.hopLength` | an omitted hopLength runs as nFft / 4, rounded down and at least 1 (was a fixed 512), so a call with nFft above 2048 and no hopLength changes output with no error: pass hopLength: 512 for the 1.x result; nFft below 1024 no longer fails for want of a hop |

#### Every call scans its input for non-finite values

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `VoiceChangeOptions.validate` | removed: every call scans its input for NaN and infinity and refuses one with RangeError, and a validate key is refused as unknown |
| `VoiceChangeRealtimeRequest.validate` | removed: every call scans its input for NaN and infinity and refuses one with RangeError, and a validate key is refused as unknown |
| `VoiceChangeRequest.validate` | removed: every call scans its input for NaN and infinity and refuses one with RangeError, and a validate key is refused as unknown |

#### String values are lowerCamelCase tokens

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `AcousticModeName='impulse_response'` | `AcousticModeName='impulseResponse'` |
| `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfigInput='bright-idol'` | `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfigInput='brightIdol'` |
| `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfigInput='dark-villain'` | `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfigInput='darkVillain'` |
| `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfigInput='deep-narrator'` | `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfigInput='deepNarrator'` |
| `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfigInput='neutral-monitor'` | `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfigInput='neutralMonitor'` |
| `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfigInput='robot-mascot'` | `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfigInput='robotMascot'` |
| `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfigInput='soft-whisper'` | `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfigInput='softWhisper'` |
| `SpectralEditOptions.window` | a WindowType name only ('rect' is now 'rectangular'): an ordinal is refused (TypeError), an unknown name (RangeError) |

#### Closed sets are string unions, not numbers or IntEnums

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `NnFilterRequest.aggregate` | string -> NnFilterAggregate ('mean'\|'median'\|'min'\|'max'); other strings refused with RangeError |
| `realtimeVoiceChangerPresetConfig` | realtimeVoiceChangerPresetConfig(preset: VoicePresetId): RealtimeVoiceChangerConfig; numeric ordinals refused (TypeError) |
| `scaleMaskForMode` | scaleMaskForMode(root: PitchClass, mode: KeyMode): number; numbers and Mode refused (TypeError) |

#### Results are typed values, not JSON strings

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `masteringRepairDeclick` | returns DeclickResult { samples, report } instead of a bare Float32Array; the report is the one the stereo call gives per channel |
| `masteringRepairDeclip` | returns DeclipResult { samples, report } instead of a bare Float32Array; the report is the one the stereo call gives per channel |
| `masteringRepairDecrackle` | returns DecrackleResult { samples, report } instead of a bare Float32Array; the report is the one the stereo call gives per channel |
| `masteringRepairDehum` | returns DehumResult { samples, report } instead of a bare Float32Array; the report is the one the stereo call gives per channel |
| `masteringRepairDenoiseClassical` | returns DenoiseResult { samples, report } instead of a bare Float32Array; the report is the one the stereo call gives per channel |
| `masteringRepairDereverbClassical` | returns DereverbResult { samples, report } instead of a bare Float32Array; the report is the one the stereo call gives per channel |
| `masteringRepairTrimSilence` | returns TrimSilenceResult { samples, report } instead of a bare Float32Array; the report is the one the stereo call gives per channel; a trim that kept nothing gives empty samples, not an error |

#### Two-dimensional results are one Matrix2D type

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `DecomposeRequest.nFeatures` | removed: the Matrix2D input carries it as rows / cols |
| `DecomposeRequest.nFrames` | removed: the Matrix2D input carries it as rows / cols |
| `DecomposeRequest.s` | Float32Array -> Matrix2D; rows are features, columns are frames |
| `DecomposeRequest` | removes `nFeatures`; removes `nFrames`; `init` is now `NmfInit` (was `"random" \| "nndsvd"`); `s` is now `Matrix2D` (was `Float32Array`) |
| `NnFilterRequest.nFeatures` | removed: the Matrix2D input carries it as rows / cols |
| `NnFilterRequest.nFrames` | removed: the Matrix2D input carries it as rows / cols |
| `NnFilterRequest.s` | Float32Array -> Matrix2D; rows are features, columns are frames |
| `NnFilterRequest` | removes `nFeatures`; removes `nFrames`; `aggregate` is now `NnFilterAggregate` (was `string`); `s` is now `Matrix2D` (was `Float32Array`) |

#### Cheap scalar state reads are getters and properties

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `RealtimeVoiceChanger.latencySamples` | readonly getter latencySamples: number |
| `RealtimeVoiceChanger.nonFiniteDiscardCount` | readonly getter nonFiniteDiscardCount: number |
| `StreamingRetune.grainSize` | `StreamingRetune.grainSizeSamples`: readonly getter grainSizeSamples: number |
| `StreamingRetune.latencySamples` | readonly getter latencySamples: number |

#### Each operation has exactly one entry point

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `HpssWithResidualRequest` | removed: Use HpssRequest with withResidual: true. |
| `PitchCorrectToMidiTimevaryingRequest` | removed: Use PitchCorrectTimevaryingRequest with targetMode: 'midi' and targetMidi. |
| `hpssWithResidual` | removed: Call hpss({ samples, sampleRate, withResidual: true }); the result then also carries residual. |
| `pitchCorrectToMidiTimevarying` | removed: Call pitchCorrectTimevarying with targetMode: 'midi' and targetMidi, plus samples, sampleRate and f0Hz. |

#### Channel counts are numChannels

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `RealtimeVoiceChanger.processInterleavedInto` | processInterleavedInto(input: Float32Array, numChannels: 1 \| 2, output: Float32Array): void |
| `RealtimeVoiceChangerOptions.channels` | `RealtimeVoiceChangerOptions.numChannels`: channels -> numChannels (1 \| 2), required: the channel count of the caller's stream has no default (was 1) |
| `VoiceChangeRealtimeRequest.samples` | `RealtimeVoiceChangerRenderRequest.channels`: samples -> channels (Float32Array[] (1 or 2 planar channels, equal lengths); was interleaved `samples` + count `channels`) |

#### Pass filters are spelled HighPass, LowPass and BandPass

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfig.eqHighpassHz` | `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfig.eqHighPassHz`: eqHighpassHz -> eqHighPassHz |

#### Frequency bounds are f0MinHz/f0MaxHz and fminHz/fmaxHz

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `PitchDecompositionResult.centreHz` | `PitchDecompositionResult.centerHz` |

#### Pitch and formant shifts are named in semitones

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `NoteEdit.formantShiftSemitones` | `NoteEdit.formantSemitones` |
| `NoteEdit.pitchShiftSemitones` | `NoteEdit.pitchSemitones` |
| `PitchShiftRequest.semitones` | `PitchShiftRequest.pitchSemitones`: semitones -> pitchSemitones |
| `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfig.retuneSemitones` | `RealtimeVoiceChangerConfig.retunePitchSemitones`: retuneSemitones -> retunePitchSemitones |
| `StreamingRetuneConfig.semitones` | `StreamingRetuneConfig.pitchSemitones`: semitones -> pitchSemitones (renamed) |
| `StreamingRetuneConfig` | removes `grainSize`; removes `semitones`; adds `grainSizeSamples?: number`; adds `pitchSemitones?: number` |

#### One type name per record on every surface

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `ExtractNotesRequest` | declared interface carrying the full field list (was `type ExtractNotesRequest = NoteTrackRequest`) |
| `HumDetection.harmonicDbfs` | number[] -> Float32Array |
| `NoiseDetection.bandFloorDbfs` | number[] -> Float32Array |
| `NoteTrackRequest` | `ExtractNotesRequest` |

| `DynamicRangeReport.lowPercentileDb` | optional: `-Infinity` on a silent window, absent for empty input |
| `MasteringAssistantProfile.crestFactorDb` | optional: absent for silence, where no RMS level is measured; never -Infinity |
| `MasteringAssistantProfile.integratedLufs` | T \| null -> number: `-Infinity` for silence or when nothing passes the gate, never null |
| `MasteringStreamingPreviewPlatform.integratedLufs` | T \| null -> number: `-Infinity` for silence or when nothing passes the gate, never null |
| `MatchReferenceLoudnessResult.referenceLufs` | T \| null -> number: `-Infinity` below the gate, never null |
| `MatchReferenceLoudnessResult.sourceLufs` | T \| null -> number: `-Infinity` below the gate, never null |
| `MatchTonalBalanceBand.deviationDb` | optional: `-Infinity` when only the source band is silent, absent when the reference band is silent or the band holds no bin |
| `MatchTonalBalanceBand.referenceDb` | optional: `-Infinity` for a silent band, absent when the band holds no bin |
| `MatchTonalBalanceBand.sourceDb` | optional: `-Infinity` for a silent band, absent when the band holds no bin |
| `MixAssistantTrackProfile.crestFactorDb` | optional: absent for silence or a track that could not be measured |
| `MixAssistantTrackProfile.integratedLufs` | T \| null -> optional number: `-Infinity` for a silent track, absent for a track that could not be measured |
| `MixMonoRisk.correlation` | optional: absent when either channel is silent |
| `MixMonoRisk.width` | optional: `Infinity` for a fully out-of-phase track, absent for silence |
| `StereoMonoCompatCheckResult.correlation` | optional: absent when either channel is silent |
| `StereoMonoCompatCheckResult.width` | T \| null -> optional number: `Infinity` for a fully out-of-phase pair, absent for silence |

| `MasteringDynamicsCompressorRequest.detector` | CompressorDetector; numbers refused |
| `MultibandCompressorBand.detector` | CompressorDetector ('peak'\|'rms'\|'logRms'); numbers refused |
| `PanLaw='const3dB'` | `PanLaw='const3Db'` |
| `PanLaw='const4.5dB'` | `PanLaw='const4.5Db'` |

| `StreamingEqualizer.setPhaseMode` | setPhaseMode(mode: EqPhaseMode) with EqPhaseMode = 'zero' \| 'natural' \| 'linear'; synonyms and numbers refused |

#### C extends an operation through an Options struct

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `MasteringAssistantParams` | removed: Use MasteringAssistantSettings; its fields now sit directly on the assistant request, not under params. |
| `MasteringAssistantSuggestRequest.params` | removed: Put the params fields (targetLufs, ceilingDbtp, targetPlatform, ...) directly on the request. |
| `MasteringAssistantSuggestStereoRequest.params` | removed: Put the params fields (targetLufs, ceilingDbtp, targetPlatform, ...) directly on the request. |
| `MasteringAudioProfileRequest.params` | removed: Put nFft, hopLength, truePeakOversample and detectDefects directly on the request. |
| `MasteringAudioProfileStereoRequest.params` | removed: Put nFft, hopLength, truePeakOversample and detectDefects directly on the request. |
| `MixAssistantOptions` | removed: Pass its fields (targetTrackLufs, suggestionStrength, eqMaxCutDb and the rest) directly on MixingAssistantSuggestRequest. |
| `MixStereoRequest.faderDb` | removed: Set faderDb on each MixStereoStrip in strips, one value per strip, instead of a request-level scalar or array. |
| `MixStereoRequest.inputTrimDb` | removed: Set inputTrimDb on each MixStereoStrip in strips, one value per strip, instead of a request-level scalar or array. |
| `MixStereoRequest.muted` | removed: Set muted on each MixStereoStrip in strips, one value per strip, instead of a request-level scalar or array. |
| `MixStereoRequest.panMode` | removed: Set panMode on each MixStereoStrip in strips, one value per strip, instead of a request-level scalar or array. |
| `MixStereoRequest.pan` | removed: Set pan on each MixStereoStrip in strips, one value per strip, instead of a request-level scalar or array. |
| `MixStereoRequest.width` | removed: Set width on each MixStereoStrip in strips, one value per strip, instead of a request-level scalar or array. |
| `SuggestMixSceneRequest.options` | removed: Use MixingAssistantSuggestRequest and put the option fields (targetTrackLufs, suggestionStrength, ...) directly on it. |

#### Cheap scalar state reads are getters and properties

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `StreamingEqualizer.lastAutoGainDb` | readonly getter lastAutoGainDb: number |
| `StreamingEqualizer.latencySamples` | readonly getter latencySamples: number |
| `StreamingEqualizer.nonFiniteDiscardCount` | readonly getter nonFiniteDiscardCount: number |
| `StreamingMasteringChain.latencySamples` | readonly getter latencySamples: number |
| `StreamingMasteringChain.nonFiniteDiscardCount` | readonly getter nonFiniteDiscardCount: number |
| `StreamingMasteringChain.nonFiniteSubstitutionCount` | readonly getter nonFiniteSubstitutionCount: number |

#### Each operation has exactly one entry point

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `MasteringChainRequest` | removed: Use MasterAudioRequest; the old config is now overrides, with an optional preset, and sampleRate is required. |
| `MasteringChainStereoRequest` | removed: Use MasterAudioStereoRequest; the old config is now overrides, with an optional preset, and sampleRate is required. |
| `MatchTonalBalanceLogBandsResult` | removed: Use MatchTonalBalanceResult, which both match.tonalBalance and match.tonalBalanceLogBands now return. |
| `masteringChainStereo` | removed: Call masterAudioStereo({ left, right, sampleRate, preset, overrides }); the old config is now overrides, and sampleRate is required. |
| `masteringChain` | removed: Call masterAudio({ samples, sampleRate, preset, overrides }); the old config is now overrides, and sampleRate is required. |

#### masterAudio is the mastering entry; mastering is renamed

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `MasteringPairAnalyzeRequest.analysisName` | `MasteringAnalyzePairRequest.analysis`: analysisName -> analysis (PairAnalysis (generic A)) |
| `MasteringPairProcessRequest.processorName` | `MasteringApplyPairProcessorRequest.processor`: processorName -> processor (PairProcessor (generic P)) |

#### The ./worklet entry exports only the documented surface

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|

#### Every JSON document uses camelCase keys

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `MasteringChainConfig` | sent to the core as a version 2 chain document: a dotted key names the same path as its nesting, and the core refuses an unknown or retired key, a wrong-kind leaf, a number on a token path, an unknown token or one path given twice, naming the path under the request key it came in (overrides, config): TypeError for a wrong shape, RangeError for an out-of-domain value or unknown token, as from the 1.x facade; a non-object config stays a TypeError; null, which is also what a NaN or an infinity serializes to, is a TypeError, and an empty list a RangeError |

#### Other individual changes

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `ClippingReport.clippingRatio` | `ClippingReport.clippedRatio`: clippingRatio -> clippedRatio |
| `MasteringChainConfig.repair.declip.lpcBlend` | removed, no replacement: the declipper no longer blends an interpolation into its LPC fill: a run it cannot reconstruct is left clipped and counted in unreconstructedRuns |
| `MasteringChainConfig.repair.declip` | a new linkChannels, default false: on more than one channel each channel repairs its own clipped runs and leaves every sample it did not clip bit-identical (was always the union of all channels' runs); true restores the union |
| `MeteringDynamicRangeOptions.lowPercentile` | a value outside [0, 1], or a lowPercentile above highPercentile, is a RangeError |
| `MixSceneInsert` | discriminated union over MasteringInsertName: {slot: 'pre' \| 'post', processor: P, params: MasteringProcessorParams<P>, sidechainKey?} |
| `StreamingEqualizer.setBand` | a band key EqBandInput does not declare is a TypeError listing the accepted keys, the 1.x lookaheadMs included; 1.x read any other unknown band key as absent |
| `SurroundPan.distance` | removed: had no effect: the surround panner reads only azimuth, divergence and lfe; drop it from a strip's surround pan and from a stored scene, where it is now refused as an unknown key (InvalidFormat) |
| `SurroundPan.elevation` | removed: had no effect: the surround panner reads only azimuth, divergence and lfe; drop it from a strip's surround pan and from a stored scene, where it is now refused as an unknown key (InvalidFormat) |
| `masteringAssistantSuggestChainStereo` | removed: read chainConfig from masteringAssistantSuggestStereo(request), a nested MasteringChainConfig that masterAudio takes unchanged as overrides |
| `masteringAssistantSuggestChain` | removed: read chainConfig from masteringAssistantSuggest(...), a nested MasteringChainConfig that masterAudio takes unchanged as overrides |

### Node: Realtime engine, synthesis, MIDI and playback

#### Sample rate is required wherever samples are passed

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `PlaybackRendererOptions.sampleRate` | required (was optional with a 48000 default) |

#### Handles are released with destroy() and close()

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Mixer.delete` | removed: call destroy() |
| `SampleBank.delete` | removed: call destroy() |

#### Seconds are spelled Sec and _sec

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `EngineCapturePunchRequest` | `CapturePunch`: renamed CapturePunch with startPpq/endPpq added; the enabled flag is gone, a punch window is active while CaptureOptions.punch is given |
| `EngineMetronomeConfig.clickSeconds` | `EngineMetronomeConfig.clickSec` |

#### Loudness quantities use one name per measurement

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `EngineMeterTelemetry.maxTruePeakDb` | `EngineMeterTelemetry.maxTruePeakDbtp`: maxTruePeakDb -> maxTruePeakDbtp |
| `EngineMeterTelemetry.truePeakDbL` | `EngineMeterTelemetry.truePeakDbtp`: truePeakDbL -> truePeakDbtp[0]: one entry per plane, numChannels long |
| `EngineMeterTelemetry.truePeakDbR` | `EngineMeterTelemetry.truePeakDbtp`: truePeakDbR -> truePeakDbtp[1]: one entry per plane, numChannels long |

#### A value that is not given is absent, never 0, -1 or ''

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `EngineBounceOptions.blockSize` | the 1.x default value is gone: omit it for the library default; an explicit 0 is a RangeError |
| `EngineBounceOptions.ditherBits` | with dither set, an integer in [2, 32]: 0, 1 and 33 are a RangeError reading 'options.ditherBits must be an integer in [2, 32]' (0 used to select 16) |
| `EngineBounceOptions.ditherSeed` | 0 is the seed 0; omit it for the default seed (1.x read 0 as the default seed) |
| `EngineBounceOptions.numChannels` | required; no channel count is assumed |
| `EngineBounceOptions.sourceSampleRate` | absent means the engine rate; an explicit 0 is a RangeError |
| `EngineBounceOptions.targetSampleRate` | absent keeps the source rate; an explicit 0 is a RangeError |
| `EngineBus.outputBusId` | absent is the master mix; an explicit 0 is a RangeError |
| `EngineCapturePunchRequest.enabled` | removed: a punch window is active while CaptureOptions.punch is given; omit punch to record without one |
| `EngineClip.lengthSamples` | omit it to play to the end of the source; an explicit 0 is a RangeError reading 'clips[i].lengthSamples must be an integer of at least 1' (0 used to select the end of the source) |
| `EngineExternalMidiEvent.destinationId` | `ExternalMidiEvent.destinationId`: absent for clock and transport bytes meant for every external port, instead of 0xFFFFFFFF |
| `EngineFreezeOptions.blockSize` | the 1.x default value is gone: omit it for the library default; an explicit 0 is a RangeError |
| `EngineFreezeOptions.clipId` | omit it for the default clip id; an explicit 0 is a RangeError reading 'RealtimeEngine.freezeOffline: clipId must not be 0; omit it for the default', any other value an integer in [1, 4294967295] |
| `EngineFreezeOptions.numChannels` | required; no channel count is assumed |
| `EngineGraphNode.numPorts` | omit it for the spec's channel count; an explicit 0 is a RangeError reading 'spec.nodes[i].numPorts must be an integer in [1, 2147483647]' (0 used to select the channel count) |
| `EngineMetronomeConfig.clickSamples` | clickSamples and clickSec are both optional: omit both for the click length derived from the click duration; an explicit 0 on either is a RangeError (clickSamples in [1, 384000], clickSec in (0, 1]), and giving both is a RangeError |
| `EngineMidiClipSchedule.lengthSamples` | omit it for an open-ended clip; an explicit 0 is a RangeError reading 'clips[i].lengthSamples must be an integer of at least 1' (0 used to select open-ended) |
| `EngineMidiClipSchedule.loopLengthSamples` | an integer of at least 1, required on a looping clip; an explicit 0 is a RangeError reading 'clips[i].loopLengthSamples must be an integer of at least 1' |
| `EngineTrackLane.outputBusId` | absent is the master mix; an explicit 0 is a RangeError |
| `Mixer` | maxBlockSize: the 1.x default value is gone: omit it for the library default; an explicit 0 is a RangeError |
| `PlaybackRendererOptions.maxBlockSize` | the 1.x default value is gone: omit it for the library default; an explicit 0 is a RangeError |
| `RealtimeEngine.metronome` | returns an EngineMetronomeConfig that carries only the click-length spelling in effect |
| `RealtimeEngine.primeOfflineParameters` | blockSize is optional: omit it for the library default; an explicit 0 is a RangeError |
| `RealtimeEngine.setTrackOutputBus` | setTrackOutputBus(trackId, busId: number \| null); null is the master mix and 0 is a RangeError |
| `RenderOfflineRequest.blockSize` | the 1.x default value is gone: omit it for the library default; an explicit 0 is a RangeError |
| `SidechainCheck.reason` | T \| null -> optional: a value the result cannot give is an absent field, never null |

#### A number outside its domain is refused, never passed through

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `EngineBounceOptions.targetLufs` | absent is -14 LUFS; any finite value, 0 included, is a literal target; a non-finite value is a RangeError |

#### String values are lowerCamelCase tokens

#### Closed sets are string unions, not numbers or IntEnums

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |

| `ChannelLayout` | 'mono' \| 'stereo' \| '5.1' \| '7.1' instead of 0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3 |
| `ControllerBinding.axis` | type ControllerAxis only; a number is refused with TypeError |
| `ControllerBinding.input` | type ControllerInput only; a number is refused with TypeError |
| `EngineAutomationPoint.curveToNext` | AutomationCurve name only; a number is a TypeError |
| `EngineBounceOptions.dither` | 'rpdf' \| 'tpdf' \| 'noiseShaped'; absent is none and a number is a TypeError |
| `EngineBus.channelLayout` | ChannelLayout name |
| `EngineCaptureSource` | 'output' \| 'input' only |
| `EngineGraphConnection.mix` | 'replace' \| 'add' instead of 0 \| 1; absent is add |
| `EngineGraphNode.type` | 'passThrough' \| 'gain' instead of 0 \| 1 |
| `EngineMarker.kind` | MarkerKind name ('marker' \| 'text' \| 'lyric' \| 'cuePoint' \| 'keySignature'); a number is a TypeError |
| `EngineParameterInfo.defaultCurve` | AutomationCurve name (was a number) |
| `EngineTelemetry.error` | lowerCamel names of the engine telemetry errors instead of ordinals |
| `EngineTelemetry.type` | 'processBlock' \| 'error' instead of 0 \| 1 |
| `EngineTelemetryError` | string union of the lowerCamel error names |
| `EngineTelemetryType` | string union 'processBlock' \| 'error' |
| `EngineTrackLane.sourceChannelLayout` | ChannelLayout name ('mono' \| 'stereo' \| '5.1' \| '7.1') |
| `EngineTrackMonitorMode` | 'off' \| 'pfl' \| 'afl' only |
| `EngineTrackSend.sendTiming` | SendTiming name only; a number is a TypeError |
| `MarkerKind` | a string-union type only; the enum value is gone |
| `Mixer.addBus` | role is a MixBusRole token ('master' \| 'aux' \| 'submix'); an unknown role is a RangeError, a non-string a TypeError |
| `Mixer.setPanLaw` | takes a pan-law name only; a number is a TypeError |
| `Mixer.stripMeter` | stripMeter(strip, tap?: MeterTap); a numeric tap is a TypeError |
| `RealtimeEngine.articulation` | returns an Articulation name only |
| `RealtimeEngine.bindController` | binding.input and binding.axis are names only; a number is a TypeError |
| `RealtimeEngine.controllerNoteTracking` | takes a dimension name and returns a NoteTracking name only |
| `RealtimeEngine.setArticulation` | the articulation is a name only; a number is a TypeError |
| `RealtimeEngine.setControllerNoteTracking` | dimension and tracking are names only; a number is a TypeError |

| `SynthModRouting.destination` | type SynthModDestination only; a number is refused with TypeError |
| `SynthModRouting.source` | type SynthModSource only; a number is refused with TypeError |

| `SynthPatch.engineMode` | type SynthEngineMode only; a number is refused with TypeError |
| `SynthPatch.filterModel` | type SynthFilterModel only; a number is refused with TypeError |
| `SynthPatch.filterOutput` | type SynthFilterOutput only; a number is refused with TypeError |
| `SynthPatch.lfoShape` | type SynthLfoShape only; a number is refused with TypeError |
| `SynthPatch.retrigger` | type SynthRetrigger only; a number is refused with TypeError |
| `SynthPatch.sampleKeyTrack` | type SampleKeyTrack only; a number is refused with TypeError |
| `SynthPatch.sampleLoop` | type SampleLoopMode only; a number is refused with TypeError |
| `SynthPatch.waveform` | type SynthOscWaveform only; a number is refused with TypeError |

| `RealtimeEngine.setTrackStripEqBandJson` | removed: Call setStripEqBand(ref, bandIndex, band) with a track id as ref and an EqBandInput object; no JSON string. |

#### Each operation has exactly one entry point

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `BuiltinInstrumentConfig.destinationId` | removed: Use BuiltinSynthConfig with destinationId beside it: { destinationId, instrument } in bounce({ builtinInstruments }) or setBuiltinInstrument(destinationId, config). |
| `ExternalInstrument.destinationId` | removed: Pass destinationId beside instrument in the pair given to bounce({ instruments }), { destinationId, instrument }; the instrument itself carries none. |
| `MidiCcBindOptions` | removed: Use ProjectMidiCcBinding: minValue and maxValue now sit beside ccNumber and paramId in the one binding passed to bindMidiCc. |
| `Mixer.meterTap` | `Mixer.stripMeter` |
| `RealtimeEngine.bindMidiCc(channel)` | removed: pass channel as a field of ProjectMidiCcBinding |
| `RealtimeEngine.bindMidiCc(controller)` | removed: pass it as ccNumber in ProjectMidiCcBinding |
| `RealtimeEngine.bindMidiCc(options)` | removed: pass it as minValue and maxValue in ProjectMidiCcBinding |
| `RealtimeEngine.bindMidiCc(paramId)` | removed: pass paramId as a field of ProjectMidiCcBinding |
| `RealtimeEngine.bindMidiCcBinding` | `RealtimeEngine.bindMidiCc` |
| `RealtimeEngine.bindMidiCc` | bindMidiCc(binding: ProjectMidiCcBinding) takes one descriptor |
| `RealtimeEngine.processWithMonitor` | removed: Call process(channels, { withMonitor: true }). |
| `RealtimeEngine.setParameterSmoothed` | removed: Call setParameter(paramId, value, renderFrame, { smoothed: true }). |
| `SynthPatch.destinationId` | removed: Pass the destination id as the first argument of setSynthInstrument(destinationId, patch), or as destinationId beside instrument in a bounce pair; a destinationId field is refused. |

| `Mixer.fromSceneJson` | `Mixer.fromJson`: static fromJson(json, { sampleRate, maxBlockSize? }) replaces fromSceneJson(json, sampleRate = 48000, blockSize = 512); sampleRate is required |
| `PlaybackLoudnessMeter.constructor(channels)` | removed: pass numChannels in the options object: new PlaybackLoudnessMeter({ numChannels, sampleRate }) |
| `PlaybackLoudnessMeter.constructor(sampleRate)` | removed: pass sampleRate in the options object: new PlaybackLoudnessMeter({ numChannels, sampleRate }) |
| `RealtimeEngine.clearClipPage` | removed: call clear(pageIndex) on the ClipPageProvider |
| `RealtimeEngine.constructor(maxChannels)` | removed: pass maxChannels in the config object: new RealtimeEngine({ sampleRate, maxChannels }) |
| `RealtimeEngine.constructor` | new RealtimeEngine({ sampleRate, maxBlockSize?, commandCapacity?, telemetryCapacity?, maxChannels? }) replaces new RealtimeEngine(sampleRate, maxBlockSize, commandCapacity, telemetryCapacity, maxChannels); sampleRate is required |
| `RealtimeEngine.createClipPageProvider` | removed: new ClipPageProvider({ numChannels, numSamples, pageFrames }) creates a provider no engine owns |
| `RealtimeEngine.createFileClipPageProvider` | removed: new FileClipPageProvider({ path, ... }) creates the provider |
| `RealtimeEngine.destroyClipPageProvider` | removed: call destroy() on the ClipPageProvider |
| `RealtimeEngine.prepare(commandCapacity)` | removed: pass commandCapacity as a field of RealtimeEngineConfig |
| `RealtimeEngine.prepare(maxBlockSize)` | removed: pass maxBlockSize as a field of RealtimeEngineConfig |
| `RealtimeEngine.prepare(maxChannels)` | removed: pass maxChannels as a field of RealtimeEngineConfig |
| `RealtimeEngine.prepare(sampleRate)` | removed: pass sampleRate as a field of RealtimeEngineConfig |
| `RealtimeEngine.prepare(telemetryCapacity)` | removed: pass telemetryCapacity as a field of RealtimeEngineConfig |
| `RealtimeEngine.prepare` | prepare(config: RealtimeEngineConfig) takes the constructor object with the same defaults and validation |
| `RealtimeEngine.supplyClipPage` | removed: call supply(pageIndex, channels) on the ClipPageProvider |

| `RealtimeEngine.setSynthInstrument` | setSynthInstrument(destinationId?, patch?); the destination id leads (absent or null is destination 0) and patch.destinationId is refused; patch is a SynthPatch object only; a preset-name string is a TypeError (name the preset with { preset }) |

### Node: Projects, arrangement and vocal editing

#### Sample rate is required wherever samples are passed

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `ProjectLoopRecordingDesc.audioSampleRate` | required: the rate of the caller's capture has no default (was 48000) |

#### Sample rate is spelled sampleRate, sample_rate and --sample-rate

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `ProjectClipDesc.audioSampleRate` | `ProjectClipDesc.sampleRate` |

#### Handles are released with destroy() and close()

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Project.delete` | removed: call destroy() |
| `ProjectTimeline.dispose` | `ProjectTimeline.destroy` |
| `VocalEditDraft.dispose` | removed: call destroy() |
| `VocalEditSession.dispose` | removed: call destroy() |
| `VocalRenderJob.dispose` | removed: call destroy() |
| `VocalRenderSnapshot.dispose` | removed: call destroy() |

#### A value that is not given is absent, never 0, -1 or ''

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Project.moveClip` | the track is options.trackId, omitted to keep the track; an explicit 0 is a RangeError |
| `Project.renameTrack` | name is required |
| `Project.setClipTakes` | the active take is options.activeTakeId, omitted for the base source; an explicit 0 is a RangeError |
| `Project.setMarker(markerId)` | removed: pass it as id in ProjectMarkerInput |
| `Project.setMarker(name)` | removed: pass name as a field of ProjectMarkerInput |
| `Project.setMarker(ppq)` | removed: pass ppq as a field of ProjectMarkerInput |
| `Project.setMarker` | takes one ProjectMarkerInput; an omitted id allocates, an explicit 0 is a RangeError |
| `ProjectBounceOptions.numChannels` | an omitted width follows the scene master's layout (2 with no master) instead of always 2; the result's channels.length is the width used |
| `ProjectBounceOptions.sampleRate` | removed: Omit it; a bounce always renders at the project sample rate and ProjectBounceResult.sampleRate reports it. |
| `ProjectMidiRouteConfig.filterChannel` | typed number only; null is no longer in the type, and a null at runtime still reads as absent |
| `ProjectMidiRouteConfig.filterGroup` | typed number only; null is no longer in the type, and a null at runtime still reads as absent |
| `ProjectMidiRouteConfig.remapChannel` | typed number only; null is no longer in the type, and a null at runtime still reads as absent |
| `ProjectTempoSegment.startSample` | removed: Drop it; give the segment startPpq only, since sample positions are derived when the project is compiled. |
| `ProjectVocalEditApplyRequest.renderedStartSample` | removed: Omit it; the field was required to be 0, and the rendered range now always starts at sample 0. |
| `ProjectVocalEditApplyRequest.takeId` | absent selects the base source; an explicit 0 is refused with RangeError |
| `ProjectVocalEditApplyResult.takeId` | absent for the base source instead of 0 |
| `ProjectVocalEditDependency.takeId` | absent for the base source instead of 0 |
| `ProjectVocalRehydrateItem.takeId` | absent for the base source instead of 0 |
| `VocalApplyRequest.expectedGeneration` | optional; omitted means the draft current generation |

#### String values are lowerCamelCase tokens

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Project.addAutomationLane` | targetKind is trackFaderDb / trackPan, not the hyphenated spelling |
| `ProjectAutomationCurve='s-curve'` | `ProjectAutomationCurve='sCurve'` |
| `ProjectAutomationCurve='scurve'` | removed: spell it 'sCurve', the AutomationCurve token; 'scurve' is refused |
| `ProjectAutomationTargetKind='track-fader-db'` | `ProjectAutomationTargetKind='trackFaderDb'` |
| `ProjectAutomationTargetKind='track-pan'` | `ProjectAutomationTargetKind='trackPan'` |
| `ProjectFadeCurve='equal-power'` | `ProjectFadeCurve='equalPower'` |
| `ProjectFadeCurve='equal_power'` | `ProjectFadeCurve='equalPower'` |
| `ProjectFadeCurve='equalpower'` | `ProjectFadeCurve='equalPower'` |
| `ProjectFadeCurve='exp'` | `ProjectFadeCurve='exponential'` |
| `ProjectFadeCurve='log'` | `ProjectFadeCurve='logarithmic'` |
| `WarpMode='tempo-sync'` | `ProjectWarpMode='tempoSync'` |
| `WarpMode='time-stretch'` | `ProjectWarpMode='timeStretch'` |

#### Closed sets are string unions, not numbers or IntEnums

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `BuiltinSynthConfig.waveform` | the waveform is a name; a number is refused with TypeError |
| `PROJECT_AUTOMATION_TARGET_OPAQUE` | removed: Pass the string 'opaque' as targetKind; numeric target kinds are refused. |
| `PROJECT_AUTOMATION_TARGET_TRACK_FADER_DB` | removed: Pass the string 'trackFaderDb' as targetKind; numeric target kinds are refused. |
| `PROJECT_AUTOMATION_TARGET_TRACK_PAN` | removed: Pass the string 'trackPan' as targetKind; numeric target kinds are refused. |

| `Project.annotateKeys` | mode is a name |

| `Project.setTrackKind` | kind is a name; a number is a TypeError |
| `ProjectAutomationCurve` | the same tokens as AutomationCurve; an ordinal is a TypeError and the 'scurve' spelling is refused |

| `ProjectKeySegment.mode` | a ProjectKeyMode token instead of an ordinal; a number is refused with TypeError |
| `ProjectMidiCcBindingKind` | 'controlChange7' \| 'controlChange14' \| 'rpn' \| 'nrpn' (was 0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3); an ordinal is a TypeError |

| `ProjectVocalReason` | `VocalReason` |

| `ProjectVocalRehydrateItem.status` | 'rehydrated' \| 'alreadyReady' \| 'unresolved' instead of 0 \| 1 \| 2 |

| `keyModeFromAnalysis` | returns a ProjectKeyMode token ('major', 'dorian', ...) instead of an ordinal |

#### Results are typed values, not JSON strings

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Project.compile` | returns { diagnostics } with named codes and severities, plus timeline when withTimeline is set |
| `Project.exportClipFile` | returns a plain Uint8Array, not a Buffer |
| `Project.exportSmf` | returns a plain Uint8Array, not a Buffer |
| `Project.lastBounceCompileResult` | returns { diagnostics } only |
| `Project.previewMidiFxCount` | takes a MidiFxConfig object in the request's config field instead of a configJson string; a non-object config is a TypeError, and an unknown key (a 1.x snake_case key among them) or a wrong-typed field is a TypeError and an out-of-domain value a RangeError, each naming its place under config ('config.velocityGamma must be > 0') |
| `ProjectCompileResult.hasTimeline` | removed: Check whether diagnostics holds an entry with severity 'error'; none means it compiled. compile({ withTimeline: true }) returns the timeline itself. |
| `ProjectCompileResult.messages` | removed: Read diagnostics, an array of ProjectDiagnostic, and use each entry's message. |
| `ProjectMidiFxBakeRequest.configJson` | `ProjectMidiFxBakeRequest.config` |
| `ProjectMidiFxPreviewRequest.configJson` | `ProjectMidiFxPreviewRequest.config` |

#### Public types never expose Wasm* names

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `VocalUint64` | removed: 64-bit counters in VocalStateToken are plain decimal strings |

#### Cancellation uses signal for promises and cancel for sync calls

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `VocalRenderRequest.signal` | `VocalRenderAsyncRequest.signal` |
| `VocalRenderRequest` | carries cancel?: () => boolean instead of signal and is the request of render only; renderAsync takes VocalRenderAsyncRequest (range, requestId, signal) and beginRenderJob takes VocalRenderJobRequest (range, requestId) |
| `VocalRenderSnapshot.beginRenderJob` | takes VocalRenderJobRequest (range, requestId) and no signal; the caller stops the job with abort() |
| `VocalRenderSnapshot.render` | takes cancel: () => boolean, polled between render work units, instead of signal; returning true throws SonareError code Cancelled with no partial PCM |

|---|---|

| `Project.setClipLoop(loopLengthPpq)` | removed: pass loopLengthPpq as a field of ProjectClipLoopRequest |
| `Project.setClipLoop(loopMode)` | removed: pass loopMode as a field of ProjectClipLoopRequest |
| `Project.setClipLoop` | takes one { loopMode, loopLengthPpq, loopCrossfadePpq } object |
| `Project.setPartRig(destinationId)` | removed: pass destinationId as a field of PartRigRequest |
| `Project.setPartRig(inserts)` | removed: pass inserts as a field of PartRigRequest |
| `Project.setPartRig(mode)` | removed: pass mode as a field of PartRigRequest |
| `Project.setPartRig(part)` | removed: pass part as a field of PartRigRequest |
| `Project.setPartRig` | takes one request object; the positional form is gone; inserts the library refuses are a TypeError (wrong shape: a wrong type, a missing processor or an unknown key inside an insert) or a RangeError (out of domain) instead of SonareError InvalidFormat, naming the place under inserts ('inserts must hold 1 to 8 entries for a chain rig'); a params key the processor does not read is refused as a TypeError ('unknown key inserts[0].params.drive (expected aliasing, ceiling, driveDb, mix)') and an unknown processor reads 'inserts[0].processor must name an insert processor'; inside a loaded project document a wrong type and a chain no player can build are InvalidFormat instead of dropping the entry |

| `Project.clipCount` | removed: Call clips() and use the length of the returned array. |
| `Project.getAssistSidecar` | removed: Call assistSidecars() and pick the entry you need from the returned array. |
| `Project.markerByIndex` | `Project.markers`: markers() returns every entry as an array; read markers()[index] instead of markerByIndex(index) |
| `Project.markerCount` | removed: Call markers() and use the length of the returned array. |
| `Project.sourceByIndex` | `Project.sources`: sources() returns every entry as an array; read sources()[index] instead of sourceByIndex(index) |
| `Project.sourceCount` | removed: Call sources() and use the length of the returned array. |
| `Project.tempoSegmentByIndex` | `Project.tempoSegments`: tempoSegments() returns every entry as an array; read tempoSegments()[index] instead of tempoSegmentByIndex(index) |
| `Project.tempoSegmentCount` | removed: Call tempoSegments() and use the length of the returned array. |
| `Project.timeSignatureByIndex` | `Project.timeSignatures`: timeSignatures() returns every entry as an array; read timeSignatures()[index] instead of timeSignatureByIndex(index) |
| `Project.timeSignatureCount` | removed: Call timeSignatures() and use the length of the returned array. |
| `Project.trackByIndex` | `Project.tracks`: tracks() returns every entry as an array; read tracks()[index] instead of trackByIndex(index) |
| `Project.trackCount` | removed: Call tracks() and use the length of the returned array. |

#### Each operation has exactly one entry point

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `BuiltinSynthConfig.destinationId` | removed: Pass the destination id as the first argument of setBuiltinInstrument(destinationId, config), or as destinationId beside instrument in a bounce pair; a destinationId field is refused. |
| `Project.bounceWithBuiltinInstrument` | removed: Call bounce({ ...options, builtinInstruments: [...] }). |
| `Project.bounceWithBuiltinInstruments` | removed: Call bounce({ ...options, builtinInstruments: [...] }). |
| `Project.bounceWithInstrument` | removed: Call bounce({ ...options, instruments: [...] }). |
| `Project.bounceWithInstruments` | removed: Call bounce({ ...options, instruments: [...] }). |
| `Project.bounceWithSf2Instrument` | removed: Call bounce({ ...options, sf2Instruments: [...] }). |
| `Project.bounceWithSf2Instruments` | removed: Call bounce({ ...options, sf2Instruments: [...] }). |
| `Project.bounceWithSynthInstrument` | removed: Call bounce({ ...options, synthInstruments: [...] }). |
| `Project.bounceWithSynthInstruments` | removed: Call bounce({ ...options, synthInstruments: [...] }). |
| `Project.compileTimeline` | removed: Call compile({ withTimeline: true }); the result then also carries timeline. |
| `Project.setMarkerEx` | removed: Call setMarker(input) with a ProjectMarkerInput; omit id to allocate a new marker. It returns the marker id. |
| `Project.setMidiFx` | removed: Call bakeMidiFx({ clipId, config }) with a MidiFxConfig object. |
| `Project.setProgram(bank)` | removed: bank moves into options as { msb, lsb }: setProgram(clipId, program, { bank: { msb, lsb } }) |
| `Project.setProgramOnChannel` | removed: Call setProgram(clipId, program, { bank, group, channel }). |
| `ProjectCompileTimelineResult` | removed: Use ProjectCompileResult; compile({ withTimeline: true }) fills its timeline. |
| `Sf2InstrumentConfig.destinationId` | removed: Pass the destination id as the first argument of setSf2Instrument(destinationId, config), or as destinationId beside instrument in a bounce pair; a destinationId field is refused. |

#### Synchronous construction is new X(config); create() is async

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `ClipPageProvider.constructor(engine)` | removed: pass { numChannels, numSamples, pageFrames }; the provider is no longer bound to an engine or addressed by id |
| `ClipPageProvider.constructor(id)` | removed: pass { numChannels, numSamples, pageFrames }; the provider is no longer bound to an engine or addressed by id |
| `ClipPageProvider.id` | removed: a clip names its provider by instance, not by id |
| `ClipPageProvider` | constructor(options: ClipPageProviderOptions) with { numChannels, numSamples, pageFrames } replaces construction through the engine; clear() after destroy() is InvalidState instead of a no-op |
| `FileClipPageProvider.constructor(engine)` | removed: pass path in the options object: new FileClipPageProvider({ path, ... }); the provider is not bound to an engine |
| `FileClipPageProvider.constructor(id)` | removed: the provider is not addressed by id |
| `FileClipPageProvider.constructor(path)` | removed: pass path in the options object: new FileClipPageProvider({ path, ... }); the provider is not bound to an engine |
| `FileClipPageProvider.id` | removed: a clip names its provider by instance, not by id |
| `FileClipPageProvider` | constructor(options: FileClipPageProviderOptions) with path inside the options object replaces (engine, path, options) |
| `Project.create` | removed: call new Project() |
| `ProjectTimeline.constructor` | removed: not constructible; get a timeline from Project.compile({ withTimeline: true }) and install it with RealtimeEngine.applyProjectTimeline() |

#### Multichannel audio is planar: channels plus sampleRate

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `ExternalSeparatedStem.planarSamples` | `ExternalSeparatedStem.channels` |
| `Project.addClip` | audio comes as planar channels with sampleRate |
| `Project.bounce` | returns planar { channels, sampleRate }; blockSize, numChannels and totalFrames are omitted for the default |
| `Project.importExternalStems` | each stem carries channels instead of planarSamples, and layout is a name |
| `Project.setSourceAudio(audio)` | removed: pass it as channels in ProjectSourceAudioRequest |
| `Project.setSourceAudio(channels)` | removed: drop the count; the channel count is channels.length in ProjectSourceAudioRequest |
| `Project.setSourceAudio(sampleRate)` | removed: pass sampleRate as a field of ProjectSourceAudioRequest |
| `Project.setSourceAudio(sourceId)` | removed: pass sourceId as a field of ProjectSourceAudioRequest |
| `Project.setSourceAudio` | takes one { sourceId, channels, sampleRate } object with planar channels |
| `ProjectClipDesc.audioChannels` | removed: Pass planar channels: Float32Array[] with sampleRate; the channel count is channels.length, so no count field is needed. |
| `ProjectClipDesc.audio` | `ProjectClipDesc.channels` |

#### Channel counts are numChannels

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `ProjectLoopRecordingDesc.audioChannels` | required with interleaved audio: the channel count of the caller's capture has no default (was 1); planar audio takes its count from the channel arrays and refuses audioChannels with TypeError |
| `ProjectSource.channelCount` | `ProjectSource.numChannels` |

#### Setters take labelled objects, not positional booleans

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Project.autoTempo(applyTimeSignatures)` | removed: pass applyTimeSignatures as a field of ProjectAutoTempoOptions |
| `Project.autoTempo(candidateIndex)` | removed: pass candidateIndex as a field of ProjectAutoTempoOptions |
| `Project.autoTempo` | takes (samples, sampleRate, options?) or one request; candidateIndex and applyTimeSignatures are options |

#### Frequency bounds are f0MinHz/f0MaxHz and fminHz/fmaxHz

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `ProjectTranscribeRequest.fmax` | `ProjectTranscribeRequest.f0MaxHz` |
| `ProjectTranscribeRequest.fmin` | `ProjectTranscribeRequest.f0MinHz` |

#### One type name per record on every surface

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `BuiltinInstrumentConfig` | `BuiltinSynthConfig` |
| `ProjectClipFade` | `ProjectClipFadeRequest`: lengthPpq and curve become fadeInPpq/fadeInCurve and fadeOutPpq/fadeOutCurve; setClipFade takes the one request |
| `ProjectTempoCandidate.timeSignature` | `ProjectTempoCandidate.firstTimeSignature` |
| `WarpMode` | `ProjectWarpMode` |

#### Input-only types are named <Name>Input

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `VocalNote.analysisFrameEnd` | number instead of a decimal string |
| `VocalNote.analysisFrameStart` | number instead of a decimal string |
| `VocalRenderResult.cacheHitUnits` | number instead of a decimal string |
| `VocalRenderResult.dryPassedFrames` | number instead of a decimal string |
| `VocalRenderResult.limitedCorrectionFrames` | number instead of a decimal string |
| `VocalSessionLimits.maxCacheBytes` | number instead of a decimal string |
| `VocalSessionLimits.maxHistoryBytes` | number instead of a decimal string |

#### Each list input takes one item form

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Project.setMidiEvents` | events are { ppq, word0, word1? } objects only; the [ppq, data0, data1] tuple and the data0/data1 keys are a TypeError |

#### Historical aliases are removed

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `ProjectAutomationPoint.curve` | removed: set curveToNext, the one name for the curve to the next breakpoint |

#### Versions and features come from *AbiVersion() and capabilities()

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `EXPECTED_PROJECT_ABI_VERSION` | removed: no longer exported; the binding checks ABI compatibility at load and throws AbiMismatch, and capabilities().abi reports the loaded versions |
| `VocalCapabilities.apiVersion` | `VocalCapabilities.abiVersion` |

#### RealtimeEngine and SonareEngine share one vocabulary

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `ProjectMidiEvent.data0` | `ProjectMidiEvent.word0` |
| `ProjectMidiEvent.data1` | `ProjectMidiEvent.word1` |

#### Other individual changes

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `AlignTakeToReferenceRequest.binsPerOctave` | a value whose top chroma bin reaches half of sampleRate is a RangeError naming binsPerOctave and sampleRate (24 bins per octave needs a rate above 8 kHz); lower binsPerOctave or raise the rate (was a bare 'Invalid parameter') |
| `AlignTakeToReferenceRequest.hopLength` | an integer in [0, 65536] (RangeError 'alignTakeToReference: hopLength must be an integer in [0, 65536]'); 0 still selects the library hop; a negative hop was refused as a bare 'Invalid parameter' and a hop above 65536 was passed on to the constant-Q stage |
| `Project.setMixerSceneJson` | returns void (was one warning string per unknown key); an unknown scene key is refused as InvalidFormat naming the key, and a scene document is version 2: any other version is refused as InvalidFormat and an absent version reads as 2, so a stored 1.x scene needs version set to 2 and its surroundPan distance and elevation keys removed |
| `ProjectClipFade.curve` | removed: give fadeInCurve or fadeOutCurve on ProjectClipFadeRequest |
| `ProjectClipFade.lengthPpq` | removed: give fadeInPpq or fadeOutPpq on ProjectClipFadeRequest |
| `ProjectMidiCcBinding.ccLsbNumber` | an integer in [0, 127]; a value from 128 to 255 is a RangeError reading 'ccLsbNumber must be an integer in [0, 127]' under bindMidiCc, midiCcToBreakpoint and midiParamToCc (1.x let a selector byte in that range through and refused a bad controller number without naming the field) |
| `ProjectMidiCcBinding.ccNumber` | an integer in [0, 127]; a value from 128 to 255 is a RangeError reading 'ccNumber must be an integer in [0, 127]' under bindMidiCc, midiCcToBreakpoint and midiParamToCc (1.x let a selector byte in that range through and refused a bad controller number without naming the field) |
| `ProjectMidiCcBinding.selectorLsb` | an integer in [0, 127]; a value from 128 to 255 is a RangeError reading 'selectorLsb must be an integer in [0, 127]' under bindMidiCc, midiCcToBreakpoint and midiParamToCc (1.x let a selector byte in that range through and refused a bad controller number without naming the field) |
| `ProjectMidiCcBinding.selectorMsb` | an integer in [0, 127]; a value from 128 to 255 is a RangeError reading 'selectorMsb must be an integer in [0, 127]' under bindMidiCc, midiCcToBreakpoint and midiParamToCc (1.x let a selector byte in that range through and refused a bad controller number without naming the field) |
| `ProjectVocalEditApplyRequest.sve1` | `ProjectVocalEditApplyRequest.vocalState` |

## WASM

Names are listed with the package entry point that exports them: `@libraz/libsonare` (`.`), `./analysis`, `./worklet` and `./vocal-edit-worker`. The conventions are those of the Node section.

### WASM: Loading, versions, audio buffers and errors

#### Sample rate is required wherever samples are passed

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.fromBuffer(sampleRate)` | required: the rate of the caller's samples has no default (was 48000) |

#### Sample rate is spelled sampleRate, sample_rate and --sample-rate

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.resample(targetSr)` | `Audio.resample(targetSampleRate)` |
| `Audio.timeStretch(rate)` | removed: pass it as speedRatio in TimeStretchRequest |
| `Audio.timeStretch` | timeStretch(options: Omit<TimeStretchRequest,'samples'\|'sampleRate'>) |

#### Classes that wait on a worker destroy asynchronously

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `OfflineWorkerClient.dispose` | `OfflineWorkerClient.destroy`: a second destroy() returns the same promise |
| `OfflineWorkerClientOptions.terminateWorkerOnDispose` | `OfflineWorkerClientOptions.terminateWorkerOnDestroy` |

#### Seconds are spelled Sec and _sec

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.duration` | `Audio.durationSec` |

#### Physical quantities carry their unit in the name

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `Audio.ebur128LoudnessRange` | `Audio.ebur128LoudnessRangeLu` |
| `Audio.spectrumFrame(frameOffset)` | `Audio.spectrumFrame(startSample)` |
| `Audio.truePeakDb(oversampleFactor)` | `Audio.truePeakDbtp(oversampleFactor)` |
| `Audio.truePeakDb` | `Audio.truePeakDbtp` |

#### A value that is not given is absent, never 0, -1 or ''

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `CapabilityCatalogChainList.processor` | T \| null -> optional: a value the result cannot give is an absent field, never null |
| `CapabilityCatalogChainStage.processor` | T \| null -> optional: a value the result cannot give is an absent field, never null |
| `projectAbiVersion` | returns undefined instead of 0 when the feature is compiled out |
| `vocalEditApiVersion` | `vocalEditAbiVersion`: returns undefined instead of 0 when the feature is compiled out |

| 1.x | 2.0.0 |

| `ValidateOptions` | removed: no call takes a validate option, and every call scans its input for NaN and infinity |
